Cipriani Residences Miami: Topped Off, Due Summer 2027 Own Brickell All of Miami ↗ EN Overview For sale Rankings Market report Financeability News New developments Language EN Own Miami / Brickell / News / Cipriani Residences Miami Tops Off, Moves Delivery to Summer 2027 Development Oct 15, 2026 · Source: PROFILEmiami, Jul 23, 2026 · 3 min read · By Jeremías Kastensmidt , Founder & Editor · Reviewed Oct 22, 2026 · updated Oct 22, 2026 Cipriani Residences Miami Tops Off, Moves Delivery to Summer 2027 Cipriani Residences Miami has topped off at about 950 feet, reports more than 80% of its 397 homes sold and now targets summer 2027 occupancy, a year earlier than planned.

Aston Martin Residences As of October 2026, Cipriani Residences Miami at 1420 South Miami Avenue has reached its full height of about 950 feet, is reported more than 80% sold, and is scheduled for occupancy in summer 2027.
That is roughly a year earlier than the 2028 completion the project was still citing in October 2025, when the tower had just passed its 44th level.
Where construction stands The concrete structure topped off in mid-July 2026.
At about 950 feet, it is described by its team as the tallest residential building south of New York City, ahead of Aston Martin Residences at 817 feet.
It will not hold the Miami title for long: Waldorf Astoria Hotel & Residences Miami downtown is rising toward 1,049 feet.
Mast Capital is the developer, Arquitectonica designed the tower, 1508 London did the interiors and Moss Construction is the general contractor.
In October 2025 the frame was climbing one level every three working days, and it topped off about nine months later.
The developer has not said why the delivery target moved forward.
Facade, interiors and amenity floors still have to be finished before owners can close.
Sales and the remaining homes The tower holds 397 residences of one to four bedrooms.
The top 18 floors form The Canaletto Collection: six penthouses and 74 other homes.
At the topping off, the developer reported more than 80% sold to buyers from over 30 countries, with Fortune Development Sales handling sales.
In July, remaining residences started at $1.8 million, up from $1.7 million in October 2025, and Canaletto homes from $4.1 million.
Amenities cover more than 50,000 square feet: a Cipriani restaurant for residents, a pool deck, a spa, a screening room, children's spaces and a speakeasy on the 37th floor overlooking the bay.
What the towers around it trade for Own.Miami's MLS data as of October 13, 2026 gives a sense of where finished Brickell towers on this stretch actually close.
A block north at 1300 South Miami Avenue, SLS Brickell (2016) recorded 20 closed sales in the last 12 months at a median of $758 per square foot.
A block east on Brickell Avenue, Echo Brickell closed 8 at a median of $1,053, and Four Seasons Residences Miami closed 12 at $1,216.

Sold $/sqft and closings, 24 months · current asking $803/sqft Across Brickell , Own.Miami's Brickell market report, as of October 13, 2026, counts 747 closed condo sales in 12 months at a median of $610,000 and $608 per square foot, with 1,133 units for sale, 18.2 months of supply and a median of 88 days on market.

Why it matters for buyers and owners For contract holders, a summer 2027 delivery means closing and final payment are now less than a year away, which is when financing, insurance and the first association budget become real numbers.

Buyers who plan to resell or rent should expect a wave of listings at closing: with more than 300 sold homes closing at once and Brickell already at 18.2 months of supply, early resale asks will compete with each other, not just with older towers.
For owners in nearby buildings, the closest finished comparable, SLS Brickell, closes at a median of $758 per square foot, while Echo and Four Seasons close above $1,050.

Cipriani's presale prices are quoted per home, not per square foot, so recorded closings in 2027 will show where it really lands, and those deeds, not presale headlines, are the first true comparable for this part of Brickell.

Mới đây, Sở Tài nguyên và Môi trường TP.
Đà Nẵng đã phát hành thông báo mời đơn vị tham gia tư vấn xác định giá đất đối với dự án Khu nghỉ dưỡng và Nhà ở cao cấp The Empire (phân khu số 2 – phía Đông đường Trường Sa, phường Ngũ Hành Sơn).
Công tác tư vấn nhằm xác định giá đất tại thời điểm tháng 5/2009 theo quy hoạch phê duyệt tại Quyết định số 9149/QĐ-UBND ngày 22/10/2011, làm cơ sở xác định nghĩa vụ tài chính phát sinh (nếu có).
Khu nghỉ dưỡng và Nhà ở cao cấp The Empire phía Tây đường Trường Sa (Cocobay Đà Nẵng) do Công ty CP Đầu tư Phát triển và Xây dựng Thành Đô làm chủ đầu tư, tổng vốn 11.000 tỷ đồng.
Năm 2017, dự án đưa vào khai thác một phần với tour khám phá Cocobay khá hút khách, kết hợp giải trí, tham quan, lưu trú và ẩm thực.
Tuy nhiên, năm 2019, chủ đầu tư bất ngờ tuyên bố không thể thực hiện cam kết lợi nhuận với khách hàng condotel; dự án rơi vào cảnh đình trệ, hoang tàn.
Tháng 5/2024, Công ty Thành Đô báo cáo UBND và Sở Xây dựng TP.
Đà Nẵng kế hoạch tái khởi động dự án sau thời gian dài “đóng băng” vì Covid-19.
Doanh nghiệp cho biết đang gấp rút chuẩn bị, dự kiến khởi công lại từ tháng 5/2024, hoàn thành từng hạng mục theo tiến độ, muộn nhất đầu năm 2029.
Tuy nhiên, đến nay theo ghi nhận tại dự án hầu như không có gì thay đổi.
Bên trong dự án, cảnh hoang hóa kéo dài, nhiều khối nhà dang dở, trụ bê tông hoen gỉ theo thời gian.
Toàn bộ tổ hợp được quây kín bằng hàng rào tôn, phía sau là cảnh đìu hiu trái ngược với kỳ vọng ban đầu.

The building permit, issued in August 2022, followed one of the most complex approval processes ever conducted for a private project in Greece, requiring thousands of technical drawings and sign-off from multiple ministries and regulatory bodies.

ΤΟ ΑΡΘΡΟ ΣΥΝΕΧΙΖΕΙ ΜΕΤΑ ΤΗΝ ΔΙΑΦΗΜΙΣΗ The tower's foundation was completed in October 2023 after 300 piles, each 1.5 meters in diameter, were driven 35 to 50 meters into the ground, followed by the largest continuous concrete pour ever conducted in Greece: more than 40 uninterrupted hours using eight pumps and over 1,000 truck deliveries, totaling roughly 7,500 cubic meters of concrete and 1,760 tons of reinforcement steel, built to standards used on the Burj Khalifa and Petronas Towers.

The tower's architecture was designed by Foster + Partners in collaboration with Alexandros Tombazis's firm, with structural and engineering work by UK-based Buro Happold, while construction was carried out by a joint venture of Bouygues Bâtiment International and AKTOR.
More than 100 specialties and over 20 engineers work on-site daily, coordinated through shared digital design and project-management systems.

With the structural phase complete, the project has entered mechanical, electrical and interior finishing work, and future residents have begun visiting the site to select materials and finishes for their units, which LAMDA said sold out before construction even began.

ΤΟ ΑΡΘΡΟ ΣΥΝΕΧΙΖΕΙ ΜΕΤΑ ΤΗΝ ΔΙΑΦΗΜΙΣΗ Landscape design by the doxiadis+ studio incorporates native Mediterranean vegetation with low irrigation needs, aiming for a LEED Gold sustainability certification that includes reduced energy consumption and carbon footprint.
LAMDA Development CEO Odysseas Athanasiou has described the project's goal as creating an internationally significant architectural landmark centered on sustainability and quality of life.

Significant construction work remains before the tower's scheduled 2027 completion, part of the broader redevelopment of the former Elliniko airport site into one of Europe's largest urban regeneration projects.

Named after the ancient Spanish city, Olvera offers premium two and three-bedroom townhouses scheduled to be completed in Q3 2027.
Prices start from AED 1.8 million with attractive post-handover payment plans.

Inspired by the Mediterranean architecture, units at Olvera are thoughtfully designed to welcome spacious indoor-outdoor living with open floor plans, carefully planned kitchens, elegant and modern finishings, as well as access to top-class amenities, providing residents with an exceptional community living experience.

All villas and townhouses in Bloom Living’s previously launched phases have been successfully sold out, reflecting the strength of the project’s proposition as a premium community living destination that caters to the evolving needs of residents.
CEO of Bloom Holding, Carlos Wakim said: “At Bloom Holding, we pay great attention to details and prioritize excellence, which is why so many people continue to invest in our communities.
We are deeply committed to continuously delivering property that meets the demands of the market and creating homes in adherence with the highest standards of quality.

“We are confident that the high demand received from investors and end users is a direct result of the uniqueness of Bloom Living, a fully integrated community that offers a great lifestyle with long-term value.
This overwhelming response is a testament to the market confidence in Bloom Holding’s developments, and the growing need for premium properties.

“With many successful launches behind us, we believe that the launch of Olvera aligns with our vision to offer residents perfectly designed homes with modern and elegant finishings surrounded by lush greenery and top-class amenities, all within an all-inclusive, vibrant community in a prime location.” He added.
Those living within Olvera can benefit from a wide range of facilities available at Bloom Living, just within a short walking distance.

Residents can explore the beauty of nature at Bloom Living’s multiple uninterrupted, interconnected parks, and they can also enjoy their time at the community’s main Clubhouse which provides easy access to pools, sports, and recreational facilities.

Additionally, at the heart of Bloom Living lies a Town Center, a vibrant community destination that offers an array of exquisite restaurants and cafés available for both residents and visitors, as well as a variety of retail options and services such as a medical clinic, a wellness center and a supermarket, to ensure that residents can obtain all their daily necessities without the need to leave Bloom Living.
The focal point at Bloom Living will be a large lake around which residents can walk, run, and cycle on designated trails.
For gatherings and leisure activities, the community features multi-purpose amphitheaters and Sunset and Sunrise Plazas with spectacular views.
Moreover, Bloom Living comprises places of worship and two outstanding international schools.
Bloom Living features a selection of villas, townhouses, and apartments, to suit the unique needs of residents of all generations.
The highly convenient gated community is located within Zayed City and close to Zayed International Airport.
Bloom Living has been designated as an investment zone allowing buyers of all nationalities to purchase residential units in the development.

The owner and developer of Wyndham Residences is Divine One Group.

What are the housing options of Wyndham Residences?
Wyndham Residences offers a selection of modern, fully furnished apartments designed for comfort, convenience, and premium living on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah.
The development features studio and one-bedroom apartments, catering to individuals, couples, and investors seeking turnkey, hotel-branded properties.
Studio apartments start from 1.2 million AED and measure 380 sqft.
These units are compact yet efficiently designed to maximize usable space, providing an ideal option for first-time buyers, singles, or investors targeting high-demand rental properties.
Fully furnished and integrated with the Wyndham Hotels & Resorts brand, the studios offer a ready-to-move-in lifestyle with premium finishes and contemporary interiors.
One-bedroom apartments are available from 1.7 million AED, with a size of 900 sqft.
These units provide more spacious living areas, including functional bedrooms, living and dining spaces, and modern kitchens, making them suitable for small families, couples, or longer-term tenants.
The turnkey design and branded amenities enhance both comfort and investment appeal.

Overall, Wyndham Residences combines a variety of unit sizes, premium furnishings, and a strategic freehold location, making it an attractive option for homeowners and investors seeking rental income and long-term value.
What is Wyndham Residences's starting price?
The starting price of Wyndham Residences is 1,200,000 AED, offering entry-level access to fully furnished, hotel-branded apartments on Al Marjan Island.
Is Wyndham Residences Freehold or leasehold?
Wyndham Residences is a freehold development, giving buyers full ownership of their apartments with no time restrictions on Al Marjan Island.
When is Wyndham Residences's Delivery date?
The delivery date for Wyndham Residences is scheduled for December 2028.
By this time, all construction, finishing, and quality inspections are expected to be complete, allowing buyers to take possession of their fully furnished, hotel-branded apartments.

What is the Payment Plan of Wyndham Residences ?
Payment Plan: 20% Down Payment: Paid at the sales launch to reserve the unit.

Housing and Development Properties (HDP), the real estate development arm of the Housing and Development Bank, has announced the launch of its new residential project, Grand Lane, in New Cairo, with total investments estimated at approximately EGP 50 billion.

The project is being developed on an area of 98 feddans and offers a diverse mix of residential units, including standalone villas, townhouses, and apartments, designed to cater to a wide range of housing needs.
According to the company, construction will occupy only 13% of the total land area, while the remaining 87% is allocated to open and green spaces, pedestrian pathways, and community services.
Grand Lane features an integrated master plan that includes commercial zones, a social club, landscaped gardens, and a range of recreational facilities.

The development also incorporates approximately 5,200 square metres of water features, providing open views for nearly 80% of residential units, alongside swimming pools and underground parking facilities.
A central green corridor, known as the Green Spine, extends through the project for approximately 1.7 kilometres, enhancing connectivity and walkability.

Residential offerings include apartments with one to three bedrooms ranging from 68 to 195 square metres, townhouses sized between 169 and 203 square metres, and standalone villas ranging from 235 to 251 square metres.
HDP is offering flexible payment plans during the launch phase, with down payments starting at 5% and instalment periods extending up to 14 years.

As part of the project’s development, HDP has signed agreements with the US-based architecture and urban planning firm OBMI, in addition to DMA for Design and Engineering Consultancy, to design the project’s master plan in line with international planning, sustainability, and design standards.

Commenting on the launch, Amgad Hassanein, Vice Chairperson of HDP, said the company aims to develop integrated residential communities that enhance quality of life through sustainable design and comprehensive services.

HDP CEO Hossam Eissa added that Grand Lane is designed to create a balanced residential environment that seamlessly integrates housing, everyday services, and expansive green spaces within a unified urban framework.
The launch of Grand Lane forms part of HDP’s broader strategy to expand its portfolio of residential developments across Egypt’s new urban communities.

Contact us About the Project Tropical Contemporary Design Umah Ubud is our design for three 2-bedroom villas in the hills of Ubud, Bali's spiritual and cultural heartland.
They share one parcel in the jungle, on the edge of a working rice field, and each has its own private plunge pool.
There are two layouts, 2BR-A and 2BR-B, both set against the rice field or jungle backdrop that Ubud's most popular rental listings are built around.
The architecture pairs whitewashed walls and full-height glass openings with dripping greenery that softens every elevation, a deliberate response to the rice-terrace landscape Ubud is known for.
Beside each pool, an arched alcove holds a cushioned daybed, and a sunken lounge sits at the water's edge.
Inside, a cactus garden grows behind steel-framed glass, and the bathroom opens to the sky around a freestanding stone tub.
The compound is walled, gated and oriented so that no villa overlooks another.
Each villa has its own outdoor lounge and its own jungle wall, with a green outlook on at least two sides.
Parking and storage are shared.
Ubud draws its own kind of guest: wellness travellers, yoga retreat visitors, honeymooners and nature-seekers who book for the setting and the atmosphere.
Umah Ubud was drawn for them, with privacy, a natural setting and design that feels deliberate.
The pictures on this page are our renders of the design.

extension terms unconfirmed No fixed completion date — reservation-anchored timeline, off-plan risk Up-to-15% rental yield is a developer projection — not independently verified USD priced but settled in IDR at contract-date FX — currency exposure Hospitality-operator developer — limited residential villa-sale track record Historic tenure/price conflict in older listings — confirm current terms at source Recommended For Investors targeting the Kuta short-let rental market with a managed asset Buyers comfortable with a defined 35-year leasehold horizon Buyers wanting a furnished, low-fit-out villa ready to let on completion Lifestyle buyers seeking a hillside ocean-view second home near Kuta village Not Recommended For Buyers who require freehold or very long (75-100 year) tenure security Risk-averse buyers unwilling to take off-plan completion risk Buyers relying on the headline 15% yield as a guaranteed return Buyers needing a developer with a long, verifiable villa-delivery record Risk Assessment Tenure horizon — 35-year lease, extension terms unconfirmed High Completion / off-plan — no fixed handover date Medium Yield realisation — 15% is an unverified projection Medium Data reliability — historic tenure/price conflicts Medium Overview Atalaya Ocean View is a development of 15 leasehold villas set in the hills above Kuta Bay, in the Sengkol area of Pujut, Central Lombok.
It is positioned for buyers seeking a hillside residence or a managed rental asset within the Kuta-Mandalika corridor, roughly 2 km from the beach and 800 metres from Kuta village.
The project is under construction, with delivery quoted at 10-12 months from reservation rather than a fixed calendar date.
The scheme offers two formats: one-bedroom villas of approximately 86.5 sqm of living area on plots of 288-295 sqm, and two-bedroom villas of approximately 177.8 sqm on plots of 322-389 sqm.

Each villa is delivered fully furnished with a private pool, a private garden and chill-out area, parking, air conditioning, fitted wardrobes, LED lighting and porcelain flooring, in a wood, steel, concrete and ceramic palette.
Villas are sold on a 35-year leasehold, with the final transaction settled in Indonesian rupiah at the contract-date exchange rate.
One-bedroom units start from USD 240,000 and two-bedroom units from USD 315,000.

The developer is Nest Hostels Group, a Valencia-based hospitality operator, working in collaboration with the Reset Lombok Hotel; the product is the sale of individual villas to private owners, with an optional in-house rental-management programme.

The site lies near the Mandalika Special Economic Zone and the Pertamina Mandalika circuit, with Lombok International Airport within driving distance, an infrastructure backdrop that underpins the area's rental thesis.
Buyers should note the relatively short 35-year tenure, confirm renewal terms, and treat the marketed up-to-15% rental yield as an unverified projection.

Sunstone by IMKAN Properties · Abu Dhabi · JRE Dubai Projects Areas Developers Guides Insights Videos Global Advisory EN AED Agent login Home / UAE / Abu Dhabi / Sunstone On sale IMKAN Properties Sunstone Abu Dhabi From AED 2,643,777 Handover Q3 2028 Enquire Brochure Overview Gallery Residences Payment Amenities Location Documents FAQ The Project From AED 2,643,777 Status On sale Handover Q3 2028 Size 1,539–3,886 sqft Residences 30 Construction under construction Furnishing Kitchen only Service charge 14 AED/sqft Sunstone is a 30-unit residential building on Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi, developed by IMKAN Properties and currently under construction.

Priced from AED 2.64 million, it offers two, three and four-bedroom residences with coastline proximity and a compact, boutique scale that distinguishes it from the larger towers that define much of the island's skyline.

# The building and its position on Al Reem Island Al Reem Island sits roughly 600 metres off Abu Dhabi's mainland, northeast of the city centre, and has spent the past decade becoming one of the emirate's most active freehold residential addresses.
The area clusters with Saadiyat Island and Al Maryah Island to form a belt of modern urban development that holds the bulk of Abu Dhabi's international residential investment.
Sunstone occupies a single building within this context.
Thirty units across one structure means the project reads as genuinely intimate by the standards of a district where large-scale towers are the norm.

IMKAN Properties, an Abu Dhabi-based developer with a track record across the UAE and North Africa, has positioned the building around a coastline-adjacent setting, giving most residences meaningful proximity to the water without the anonymity of a large complex.
The architecture draws on the contemporary vocabulary that dominates Al Reem, prioritising clean geometry and considered massing over ornament.
# Residences, layouts and interior specification The two-bedroom apartments form the core of the inventory.

Sizes within that category range from approximately 1,539 sq ft to just over 2,755 sq ft, a spread wide enough that the upper end of the two-bedroom range competes comfortably with smaller three-bedroom products elsewhere on the island.
Prices for two-bedroom units run from AED 2.64 million to AED 3.58 million, depending on floor, orientation and configuration.
Four-bedroom residences occupy the upper end of the scheme, spanning 3,137 sq ft to 3,939 sq ft and priced between AED 6.70 million and AED 7.20 million.
A single three-bedroom unit of 4,165 sq ft sits at AED 7.48 million, representing the largest and most expensive single residence in the building.
Homes are delivered with kitchens fitted out as standard.
The remainder of the interior arrives unfurnished, which suits buyers who prefer to appoint their own spaces rather than inherit a developer's furniture package.
Service charges are fixed at AED 14 per sq ft annually.
# Facilities within the development The amenity programme is focused rather than exhaustive, which suits a 30-unit building.
A pool deck provides the primary outdoor social space, supported by coastline access that extends the usable outdoor environment beyond the building's own footprint.
# Wellness and recreation The gym is described by IMKAN as a full fitness facility.
A multipurpose room adds flexibility for residents who use communal spaces for activities beyond the gym floor, and a dedicated entertainment hub rounds out the indoor provision.
The suite covers the essentials without the operational overhead of a larger resort-style complex, which typically translates to more manageable service charges for owners.
# Al Reem Island: connectivity and urban infrastructure Al Reem Island functions as a mixed-use district rather than a purely residential enclave.
Commercial centres, banks, parks and sports facilities are distributed across the island, reducing reliance on the mainland for day-to-day requirements.

The connection to central Abu Dhabi is direct, and proximity to both Saadiyat Island, home to major cultural institutions, and Al Maryah Island, the emirate's financial and retail hub, adds practical weight to the address.
For international buyers, Al Reem's status as one of Abu Dhabi's first designated freehold zones remains relevant.
The legal framework for foreign ownership is established and tested.

# Who Sunstone suits and where it sits in the Abu Dhabi market A building of 30 units appeals to buyers who find value in a smaller owner community: lower transient population, greater continuity among neighbours, and a building that does not operate at the scale of a small hotel.

The pricing, AED 2.64 million to AED 7.48 million, places Sunstone within reach of the mid-to-upper segment of Abu Dhabi's freehold residential market without crossing into the ultra-prime territory where Al Reem rarely competes.

For GCC buyers seeking a pied-à-terre with coastal proximity, or for European and Asian investors looking at Abu Dhabi as a complement to a Dubai holding, the combination of floor sizes, boutique scale and IMKAN's development profile gives the project a defensible position.
The unfurnished delivery also leaves latitude for buyers who intend to let the units, since specification choices remain their own.

Completion is scheduled for Q4 2027, with construction currently at early stage.
# The Building and Its Position on Al Marjan Island Al Marjan Island is a man-made archipelago extending into the Arabian Gulf, roughly 37.9 kilometres from Ras Al Khaimah International Airport.

It has drawn sustained developer attention over the past several years, partly on the strength of its waterfront land supply and partly in anticipation of the Wynn Al Marjan resort, which sits directly opposite The Beach Vista's site.
That adjacency is significant: it places the building at one of the island's most commercially active nodes without putting it inside a resort complex.
The building's architecture draws on the coastal setting, using expansive glazing and a terraced profile to direct views across the Gulf.
At seven units in total, it is a deliberately intimate project, a contrast to the larger-scale towers that characterise much of the island's residential pipeline.
At 2% construction progress, buyers are acquiring early in the development cycle.
The escrow account number is 01434279175, registered under the Ras Al Khaimah regulatory framework.
# Residences, Layouts and Specification The available units are two-bedroom apartments, ranging from approximately 1,590 to 1,707 square feet.
Pricing runs from AED 4.52 million to AED 5.29 million across the listed inventory, with a service charge of AED 20 per square foot per year.
At those floor plate sizes, the apartments sit at the generous end of the two-bedroom category in this part of the UAE.
Each unit comes with a fitted kitchen; the remainder is unfurnished, giving buyers latitude to specify interiors to their own standard.
The terraced structure of the building suggests that private outdoor space is a feature of the layout, though buyers should confirm terrace dimensions for specific units.
# Amenities: Pool, Gym and Concierge The amenity programme is concise.
A pool with direct beach access serves as the building's primary social and recreational space, connecting the indoor common areas to the shoreline.
The gym is available to all residents.
A co-working space addresses the practical needs of buyers who work remotely or manage businesses from the UAE, a demographic that has grown considerably in Ras Al Khaimah since 2021.
Concierge services round out the offer.
There is no spa, no cinema room, no listed food and beverage component.
For buyers accustomed to the amenity density of Dubai's larger master communities, that requires an adjustment in expectation.
For those who prefer a quieter building, it is a straightforward trade.

# Getting Around from Al Marjan Island The immediate surroundings include Pacific Buildings Beach at 0.7 kilometres, and Little Captain Nursery at roughly one kilometre, which is relevant for families with young children.
Public Park Al Marjan Island is 3.6 kilometres away.
Al Hamra Mall, the island's primary retail and dining anchor, is 10.2 kilometres by road.
Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is approximately 37.9 kilometres from the island.

Dubai International Airport is around 75 kilometres, a journey of roughly an hour by road depending on traffic conditions, though no travel time data is provided in the development's published details.
The island has no metro connection.
Residents are car-dependent, which is standard for this part of the UAE coastline.
# Who This Project Suits, and Where It Sits in the Market Seven units is an unusual figure for a published development.
It may reflect the remaining available inventory rather than the total building count, but buyers should verify the full unit count with the developer directly.

For the buyer this does suit, the profile is fairly specific: someone prioritising beachfront access and a low-density building over the breadth of amenities and community infrastructure that Dubai's larger master-planned projects provide.

At AED 4.52 million to AED 5.29 million for a two-bedroom unit of 1,600-plus square feet in Ras Al Khaimah, the per-square-foot pricing reflects both the coastal premium and the proximity to the Wynn site, which has become a pricing reference point across the island.

International buyers from the UK, Europe and Asia who are drawn to the UAE for lifestyle reasons rather than yield calculations will find Al Marjan Island's quieter, lower-density environment a material difference from central Dubai.
The Beach Vista, with its small unit count and direct beach access, positions itself at the more private end of that offer.

Midad Real Estate is building four towers here holding a 247-room Four Seasons hotel and 76 private residences, and the towers are joined by suspended bridges that each span 60 metres and carry eight floors.
Those bridges finished in November 2024 and are the largest in the Middle East.
Skidmore, Owings & Merrill did the architecture and Richmond International the interiors.
The homes run one to six bedrooms, 167.7 m² to 1,162.5 m², and the mix includes two and three bedroom duplexes as well as penthouses.
Kitchens are designer-fitted with integrated appliances, and the larger layouts carry a show kitchen alongside a service kitchen.
Bathrooms are stone, the glazing runs floor to ceiling, and every home has a balcony over the Red Sea.

What the residents get downstairs is a hotel's amenity list rather than a building's: an owners-only indoor pool kept at temperature, separate men's and women's gyms, wellness suites with private treatment rooms, a spa and hammam, a residents' lounge with sea views, private meeting rooms with an entertaining kitchen, and an outdoor terrace.
Service is Four Seasons and runs around the clock: concierge, security, property management, valet, and lifts you need a card for.
Buying starts with a booking of SAR 50,000, which is not refundable, then 35% on signing the sales agreement.
Five instalments of 10% follow every two months, and the last 15% falls at handover, so 85% is paid during construction.
Completion is June 2027.
Midad publishes stock live, unit by unit, so we can tell you what is actually free today rather than what was free when a price list was printed.
As it stands, 26 of the 76 homes are available, and the cheapest of them is SAR 6,716,214.

the Jeddah Corniche Midad Real Estate Investment Company is a Riyadh-based developer working in luxury hospitality and mixed-use.

Its Jeddah project is the one that made the company's name: a Four Seasons hotel and private residences on the Corniche, four towers designed by Skidmore, Owings & Merrill, linked by suspended bridges that each span 60 metres and carry eight floors.

Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Headquarters View Midad Real Estate About Jeddah Saudi Arabia's Red Sea gateway, with 57 approved ownership zones Jeddah is Saudi Arabia's second city and its Red Sea port , and it has always been the country's most outward-facing place.
Pilgrims have arrived here on their way to Makkah and Madinah for centuries, and it was a trading city long before anyone called it a tourist one.
That history is why it reads differently from Riyadh.
Riyadh runs on government and on the companies moving their regional headquarters there.
Jeddah runs on the coast, the events calendar and a resident population that has lived alongside foreigners for generations.
Two numbers matter to a non-Saudi buyer.
The first is 57 , the count of approved zones in Jeddah where foreign ownership is permitted under the law in force since 22 January 2026, Jeddah Central among them.
That is the widest access of any Saudi city.
The second is price: apartments here average around SAR 4,385 per m² , well under what the same space costs in the capital.

On the developer's price list of 24 September 2026 , valid for a deed of sale signed by 30 November 2026 , prices run from €860,625 to €1,800,000 , excluding registration duty and notary fees.
A Property Development Scheme estate: open to non-citizens, with a residence permit above USD 375,000 .
Checked on 12/10/2026 against the developer's price list.

The estate Tamarin, between the Rempart and La Tourelle A 1.14-hectare plot beside a stream, in a residential neighbourhood of Tamarin where planning rules require single-storey homes and leave the mountains in full view.
Amanzira occupies portion 24 of the Domain subdivision in Tamarin, in the Black River district.
To the north-east the land runs along the Rivulet Boucan, a tributary of the Tamarin river whose wooded reserve is preserved.
To the north stands the Rempart, to the south La Tourelle, the two mountains that frame Tamarin Bay.
In this area, buildings are limited to a single storey and a 20% footprint: a rule that keeps views open and density low.
The developer places the estate a short bicycle ride from Tamarin's town centre and beaches, with schools, medical services and shopping centres within five kilometres.

Tamarin Bay and its surf break, La Preneuse beach, the Tamarina golf course at the foot of the Rempart and the Black River marina make up daily life on the west coast; our Tamarin and Black River pages cover the neighbourhoods and prices.
Nine villas on 1.14 hectares Over 700 m² of land per villa on average and a built footprint under 20%: the master plan puts gardens, distance between neighbours and the shade of trees first.
A landscaped central driveway in grass pavers serves the eight Amanzi villas: odd-numbered lots, on the east side, follow the standard plan; even-numbered lots, on the west side, its mirror image.
Each villa has two private parking bays and three exclusive-use private gardens, 396 to 623 m² in total depending on the lot.
To the north, Villa Ra (lot 9) spreads over 3,658 m² of gardens sloping down to the Rivulet Boucan.
The estate is enclosed around lots 1 to 8; inside, landscaping replaces walls to keep privacy without closing off space.
The common areas include the entrance, the driveway, a technical area, a private meeting room designed as a co-working space with electric-vehicle charging, and two visitor parking bays.
The estate is built in two phases according to the division schedule of 25 September 2026: villas 1 to 5 in phase 1, villas 6 to 9 in phase 2.

The Amanzi villas The Amanzi villa, room by room A single-storey villa arranged around a through living room that opens on both sides onto the garden, the pool and the mountains.

At the heart of the villa is a 62.3 m² open living, dining and kitchen area closed by pocket sliding doors that disappear into the walls: inside and terrace are level and the room runs from one garden to the other.
The 29.9 m² main terrace looks onto a 24.7 m² private pool; a garden terrace, a 5.5 m² pantry-laundry and a study nook in the corridor complete the living space.
The master suite sits at the back, on its own garden: a 15.3 m² bedroom, an 8.7 m² walk-in wardrobe, a 9 m² bathroom with a freestanding bath and an outdoor shower, and a private terrace.
The 12.4 m² secondary bedrooms line the side of the villa, leaving the living room its full width.
The four variants share the same plan, permitted with all its options by the building permit: 2ES : two bedrooms, a bathroom shared with guests, fibreglass pool; third bedroom as an option (€30,000).
3ES : three bedrooms and two bathrooms, fibreglass pool.
3EL : three en-suite bedrooms, guest WC, tiled concrete pool.
3FL : the 3EL with a 24 m² closed garage, a 9.5 m² concrete plunge pool off the master suite and a standby generator.

Specifications of 24 September 2026: cyclone-resistant reinforced-concrete structure and roof, aluminium joinery with laminated glass, solid-wood front door, porcelain floors, granite or quartz vanity tops, low-flow taps, fitted kitchen with induction hob and oven, inverter air conditioning and ceiling fans in every bedroom, fibre optics.

Water Rainwater from the roofs is collected by the owners' association and feeds a dedicated network for toilets, pool top-up and irrigation.
Each villa has its own sewage treatment plant; the treated water is stored in an underground tank and irrigates a garden zone.
Drinking water is held in a shared reserve and metered villa by villa.

Sun Every roof carries 10 kWp of photovoltaic panels, connected to the CEB grid under the SSDG scheme; in this standard version, the panels remain the property of AquaSol, which receives the electricity revenue.

Buyers can choose a hybrid installation of 10 kWp with 16 kWh of batteries (€20,000) or an off-grid one of 25 kWp with 80 kWh of batteries (€35,000), whose electricity benefits them, subject to CEB permits.
Heat Bathroom hot water comes from a heat pump that recovers the heat rejected by the master-suite air conditioning.
Natural cross-ventilation, provision for EV chargers, low-flow taps: the estate has applied for LEED certification (ID 1000237327) with the U.S.
Green Building Council.

Buying Buying a villa at Amanzira A Property Development Scheme estate: open to non-citizens, freehold, with a residence permit for the buyer and their family.
01 The framework AquaSol Ltd holds a letter of approval from the Economic Development Board towards the PDS certificate (ref.
EDB/HPD/AML/27062, 6 May 2026) and the building and land use permit of the Black River District Council (BLP3-BRDC-2026-511, 16 June 2026).
Under this scheme, buying a villa above USD 375,000 qualifies for a residence permit.
Each buyer files an application with the EDB before the deed, with proof of identity and source of funds.
02 The reservation The preliminary reservation contract, valid for 12 months, comes with a deposit of 25% of the price held in escrow by the notary.
The deposit is refunded if the sale is not offered within that period or if the EDB application is refused.

03 The off-plan sale The deed of sale carries an extrinsic completion guarantee; the price is then called as works progress: 30% on the deed (deposit included), 5% at foundations, 35% when weathertight, 25% on completion, 5% on handover.
The estimated construction period is 24 months from the deed.

The developer takes out property damage insurance (ten years for structural works, two years for minor works) and appoints a quality assurance contractor as PDS regulations require; Socotec checks the structure and building services.
04 Customisation Options are chosen within two months of the reservation and at the latest on the deed.
The 5% registration duty and notary fees are added to the price.
AquaSol and the project team A developer from Heritage Villas Valriche and a Mauritian team of architects and engineers.

AquaSol Ltd, incorporated in 2025 to carry Amanzira, is led by Anton de Waal, former chief executive and director of Heritage Villas Valriche, the 288-villa IRS estate in Bel Ombre that he took from concept to completion between 2006 and 2024.
Architecture and interiors are by Studio Linear in Tamarin (Ilze du Pisanie and Steven Attwood).

Luxconsult handles civil and structural engineering, Prodesign building services, electrical engineering and BIM, Keystone Project Management project management; Socotec works on the decennial insurance and PRO LEED on the environmental certification.

Our editorial method → Frequently asked questions Amanzira: the key answers Where is Amanzira located?

In Tamarin, on the west coast of Mauritius, in the Domain neighbourhood (Black River district), on 11,420 m² of land beside the Rivulet Boucan, between the Rempart mountain to the north and La Tourelle to the south.
How much does a villa at Amanzira cost?

On AquaSol's price list of 24 September 2026, valid for a deed of sale signed by 30 November 2026: from €860,625 (Amanzi 2ES villa) to €1,150,000 (Amanzi 3FL villa) depending on the variant and the lot, and €1,800,000 for the four-bedroom Villa Ra, excluding the 5% registration duty and notary fees.
How many villas does the estate have?
Nine: eight single-storey Amanzi villas (lots 1 to 8), each in the 2ES, 3ES, 3EL or 3FL variant at the buyer's choice, and one four-suite Villa Ra over two levels (lot 9).
What are the areas?
Amanzi villas: 144 to 183 m² internal, 213 to 254 m² covered built area and 353 to 379 m² total construction area depending on the variant, with 396 to 623 m² of private gardens depending on the lot.
Villa Ra: 350 m² internal, 400 m² covered built area, 600 m² total construction area and 3,658 m² of private gardens.
Can a foreign buyer purchase?
Yes.
Amanzira falls under the Property Development Scheme: purchase is open to non-citizens on a freehold basis and, above USD 375,000, qualifies for a residence permit.
Each buyer files an application with the EDB before the deed of sale.
How is a villa paid for?
25% on reservation, held in escrow by the notary, then as works progress: 30% on the deed of sale (deposit included), 5% at foundations, 35% when weathertight, 25% on completion and 5% on handover.
When will the villas be delivered?
The reservation contract provides for 24 months of works from the signing of the deed of sale.
Villas 1 to 5 form the first phase, villas 6 to 9 the second; the developer has not yet given a delivery date per lot.
Are the lots still available?
All nine villas are on the price list of 24 September 2026.

About this property West Gate comprises a collection of 1, 2 & 3-bedroom deluxe apartments, each designed and delivered to the uncompromising standards for which Renaker is renowned.

Each apartment features a refined palette of premium finishes and seamless contemporary detailing, complemented by floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the interiors with natural light and frame sweeping views across the city and River Irwell.
The apartments at West Gate are further enhanced by exceptional private amenities.
Designed by Lister + Lister, the development offers an exclusive collection of five-star, resident-focused spaces arranged across four floors—unique for a scheme of this scale.

From holistic wellness to social connection, every space is carefully curated to inspire, whether enjoying a serene moment on The Luna Terrace, entertaining in the elegant Suite 39, or re-energising in Form Studio, the dedicated Pilates space.
Establishing a new riverside neighbourhood, St John’s Waterside is set to become one of Manchester’s most distinctive new addresses, with West Gate at its heart.

The location offers residents the best of both worlds: immediate city centre access combined with the calm of waterside living, featuring over 90 metres of direct river frontage and 1.65 acres of public green space, including new pathways and a riverside commercial unit.
One of Manchester's most vibrant locations with a host of amazing local amenities on your doorstep.
Nathan Riddoch Property agent Local information St John's Waterside is a new riverside neighbourhood designed to connect city life with open space and modern living.

Positioned on the banks of the River Irwell and ideally connected to Trinity Island and St John's Culture and Enterprise Quarter it forms part of a wider masterplan that reimagines this historic area as a vibrant, mixed use destination.
Neighbouring is St John's Culture & Enterprise Quarter, a flagship innovation district, a £1bn ecosystem driving over 10,100 new jobs in tech, media and creative enterprise.
With more than 560,000 sq.ft of workspace and a 3,000 strong digital workforce already in place, it's at the forefront of the city's future economy.

Within 0.6 miles of West Gate is Spinningfields, Manchester's central business district and world class hub & leisure district that has been a cornerstone to the city's success, supporting over 20,000 employee's across legal, finance and professional services across 4.5 million sq.ft of premium mixed use development that contributes over £1 billion annually to Manchester's economy.
The District is also home to globally renowned restaurants such as The Ivy, Sexy Fish and Tattu.
Manchester continues to shine for its excellence in education, with five universities attracting 116,000 new students per annum and a graduate retention rate of 51%, second only to London.

Guía interactiva de los ejecutivos claves de la Argentina Ver abre en nueva pestaña Financial Times en español Ver abre en nueva pestaña Renovación automática a precio vigente Ver todos los planes El Cronista Negocios Real Estate Osten Tower II Con una inversión de u$s 95 millones, GNV arrancó la construcción de una torre de 33 pisos La lógica del proyecto es concentrar en una misma zona vivienda, trabajo, servicios y entretenimiento, un concepto que hoy suele asociarse a la “ciudad de los 15 minutos” + Agregar El Cronista en abre en nueva pestaña Ayelén Trujillo Redactora de El Cronista Publicado el 12 de Marzo de 2026 21:17 Actualizado el 13 de Marzo de 2026 13:04 abre en nueva pestaña abre en nueva pestaña abre en nueva pestaña abre en nueva pestaña En esta noticia Todos los detalles de la nueva torre residencial de GNV Group De un restaurante premiado a una marca inmobiliaria Con una preventa que ya colocó cerca del 45% de las unidades, la desarrolladora inmobiliaria GNV Group inició la construcción de Osten Tower II , una nueva torre residencial que se levantará en el Dique 1 de Puerto Madero y que demandará una inversión total de u$s 95 millones junto con Osten Tower I.
El proyecto forma parte del Distrito Madero Harbour , un desarrollo de usos mixtos impulsado por la compañía que integra residencias, oficinas, gastronomía y comercio.

La lógica del proyecto es concentrar en una misma zona vivienda, trabajo, servicios y entretenimiento, un concepto que hoy suele asociarse a la “ciudad de los 15 minutos” La nueva torre contará con 33 pisos, más de 200 unidades de entre 40 y 310 m2 y un penthouse de casi 1000 m2 con parrilla y piscina privada.
El valor de las unidades va de los u$s 197.000 en adelante.
La entrega, en tanto, está prevista para diciembre de 2028.

Todos los detalles de la nueva torre residencial de GNV Group Diseñado por el estudio PFZ Pfeifer-Zurdo Arquitectos, el edificio contará con amenities orientadas al bienestar y la vida social, entre ellas: wellness Center, spa, business center, cancha de pádel y la primera cancha de pickleball de Puerto Madero.
Los valores arrancan en torno a los u$s 5000 por m2, con un plan de pago del 30% al firmar el boleto.
“Hay refuerzos contra hitos de obra, como la losa del piso 10 y del piso 20, además de cuotas durante la construcción”, destacaron desde la compañía.

Gracias a una mayor apertura de las importaciones , Alejandro Ginevra , presidente y fundador de GNV Group, explicó que la empresa modificó su esquema de construcción para optimizar costos y garantizar estándares de calidad en sus desarrollos.

En lugar de tercerizar gran parte de las obras -un modelo tradicional en el que intervienen contratistas y se encarecen los procesos por intermediación- la compañía decidió asumir más etapas de manera directa.
Esto significa comprar insumos por cuenta propia, adelantar capital y tomar más riesgo financiero, pero al mismo tiempo permite reducir costos y tener un mayor control sobre el proyecto.

Alejandro Ginevra explicó que la empresa modificó su esquema de construcción para optimizar costos y garantizar estándares de calidad en sus desarrollos En ese marco, la firma reforzó la incorporación de materiales importados.
Algunas cocinas, por ejemplo, se están trayendo desde Italia, mientras que las griferías provienen de Alemania.
También comenzaron a importar desde China ciertos productos, como puertas y algunos revestimientos.

El proyecto, además, incorporará tecnología habitual en edificios contemporáneos, con sistemas de seguridad y control centralizados , mientras que cada propietario podrá sumar soluciones de domótica en su unidad.
Incluso se prevé la instalación de sanitarios inteligentes, una tendencia extendida en Asia y cada vez más presente en desarrollos inmobiliarios de alta gama.

La lógica del proyecto es concentrar en una misma zona vivienda, trabajo, servicios y entretenimiento, un concepto que hoy suele asociarse a la ‘ciudad de los 15 minutos’: “Madero Harbour es la ciudad que se puede hacer caminando.
Van a tener todo a mano”, detalló Juan Pfeifer , socio fundador de PFZ Arquitectos.

Con una inversión de u$s 95 millones, GNV Group pone en marcha la construcción de una torre residencial de 33 pisos y servicios inteligentes De un restaurante premiado a una marca inmobiliaria La marca Osten nació en 2020 con la apertura de un restaurante de alta gama en Puerto Madero que rápidamente ganó visibilidad internacional al recibir el premio al mejor diseño de América en los International Restaurant & Bar Design Awards de Londres.
Ese reconocimiento llevó a la compañía a trasladar la estética y el concepto del restaurante al mundo residencial.
“Estábamos buscando una marca para un nuevo desarrollo y decidimos aprovechar algo que ya era exitoso ”, explicó Ginevra.
Así nació Osten Tower I , lanzada en 2022 y hoy completamente vendida, con entrega prevista para fines de 2026.
El buen ritmo de ventas llevó a la compañía a replicar el concepto en una segunda torre.

How can foreigners own condos in Thailand?
Foreigners can own a condominium Freehold in their own name.
Condominium ownership is best explained by looking at an example of a project that has 100 units for sale.
In this example, 49 of the total units in this building (or 49% of the total salable area) can be owned outright by non-thai nationals in their name.
The ownership titles of these 49 units is referred to as Freehold or Foreign Quota.
This leaves 51 units remaining in the building (or 51% of the total salable).
The freehold rights to these units are reserved for Thai nationals in what is commonly referred to as the Thai quota.
What is the process of a property purchase in Thailand?

After you have found the right property, you have to follow these steps: - Agreement of terms and conditions - Reservation Agreement - Reservation Deposit - Sales and Purchase Agreement - Settlement & Transfer Can I purchase and transfer a property in my name from being outside the country (Thailand)?
This option has surged in popularity in recent years.
We offer immersive online tours for a wide range of properties, allowing you to explore them from the comfort of your home.
Our seasoned team can also arrange personalized video tours.

When you're ready to proceed with your purchase, we can seamlessly guide you through the entire property transfer process, and if needed, recommend a trusted lawyer to handle the transaction on your behalf, even if you're not physically present.
What type of visa can I get?
Thailand has different visas like Spousal Visa, Retirement Visa, Student Visa and Elite Visa - just to name a few options.
Each visa has different requirements, but they are usually easy to obtain.

Dusit Ajara Hua Hin Sets New Standard for Sustainable Luxury Living Business Dusit Ajara Hua Hin Sets New Standard for Sustainable Luxury Living TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 24, 2026 สลับเป็นเสียงผู้ชาย Play Loading...

Seven key dimensions reinforce Hua Hin's property potential, with branded residences offering gross rental yields of 7–9% Dusit Estate has launched Dusit Ajara Hua Hin, a low-density luxury branded residence development based on the concept of "Sustainable Well-Being," dedicating over 60% of its land to green space.

The project sets a new sustainability standard by being the first in Asia to adopt the "Fitwel: Low Rise Residential" framework for health-focused design and using SCG Green Choice certified materials.
It blends luxury living with Dusit's hospitality legacy, offering 96 fully furnished units designed for multi-generational and pet-friendly lifestyles.
As a branded residence in an undersupplied market, the development is projected to offer gross rental yields of 7–9%, supported by infrastructure improvements in Hua Hin.
Seven key dimensions reinforce Hua Hin's property potential, with branded residences offering gross rental yields of 7–9%.
Dusit Estate has unveiled its vision for Dusit Ajara Hua Hin, a luxury branded residence development promising to redefine sustainable living in one of Thailand's most enduring seaside destinations.

Presented under the concept of "Sustainable Well-Being" , the project was introduced at a press conference on Tuesday alongside senior representatives from Siam Cement Group (SCG), CBRE Thailand, Arkitektura, Architects 49, P Landscape, and Dusit Thani Hua Hin.

Set on more than 20 rai of land, the low-rise, low-density development will comprise just 96 units, with over 60% of the site dedicated to green space under a design concept the developers call "Bridging Oasis".
Completion and handover are anticipated in 2028.
La-ead Kovavisaruch , managing director of Dusit Estate, described the project as a natural extension of the group's 75-year hospitality legacy.
"We are extending this expertise into the development of branded residences," she said, noting the project's focus on multi-generational and pet-friendly living.

"Dusit Ajara Hua Hin is designed to harmoniously connect nature and architecture, delivering a seamless transition from hospitality to everyday living." A sustainable foundation from day one SCG's involvement centres on health-focused design.

The project has adopted the Fitwel standard — a framework developed by the United States' Centres for Disease Control and Prevention — under its "Fitwel: Low Rise Residential" classification, which SCG describes as the first application of this standard in Asia.

Wachirachai Koonamwattana , chief sustainability Officer at SCG, said the project demonstrates that "sustainability is not an added feature, but a foundation established from day one." Environmentally friendly materials certified under SCG's Green Choice label will be used throughout, with a focus on energy efficiency, climate resilience, and circular economy principles.
Wachirachai stressed that sustainability has been embedded from the outset rather than retrofitted, ensuring long-term quality of life for residents.

Hua Hin's property market gathers momentum CBRE Thailand's Artitaya Kasemlawan highlighted the investment case for the project, pointing to a branded residences segment where supply is limited but demand remains steady.
Gross rental yields are estimated at between 7% and 9%.

According to the Real Estate Information Centre, no new condominium projects were launched in Prachuap Khiri Khan and Phetchaburi provinces by the end of 2025, creating a balanced — and arguably undersupplied — market.

She also pointed to broader infrastructure improvements supporting Hua Hin's long-term appeal, including the development of Hua Hin Airport and a planned intercity motorway designed to ease congestion on Rama II Road and improve connectivity between Hua Hin and Cha-am.

Hospitality heritage meets residential living The project is being developed on part of the grounds of Dusit Thani Hua Hin — formerly the site of the Dusit Resort & Polo Club.
Pipat Patthananusorn , Area general manager at Dusit Thani Hua Hin, said the location carries more than 30 years of hospitality history.
"Hua Hin is not merely a destination, but a relationship," he said, describing the development as part of a wider mixed-use precinct spanning more than 100 rai.
Pipat described the development as a reflection of Hua Hin's evolution from a leisure destination into a place where people genuinely choose to live.

Architecture shaped by climate and context Architects 49 led the architectural design, with deputy managing director Somkiat Lo-chindapong emphasising an approach tailored to Hua Hin's coastal climate — prioritising natural ventilation, daylight and shaded transitional spaces.

Landscape firm P Landscape designed the outdoor environment as an integral part of daily life, incorporating communal lawns, a jogging track, children's areas, pet-friendly spaces, and a loop pool suited to residents of all ages.

Hathai Rojanasripairot , design director of P Landscape, said that the landscape was designed to cultivate a genuine sense of tranquillity and connection — with nature, with the community, and with oneself.
All 96 units will be delivered fully furnished through a collaboration with Arkitektura , using pieces from Caracole, a luxury American furniture brand.
The "Relaxed Luxury" aesthetic blends classical and contemporary influences, enabling residents to move in immediately upon handover.

Somchai Akkarawittayapoom , managing director of Arkitektura, described the approach as one that removes complexity for buyers while ensuring consistent quality and spatial coherence throughout the development.
The project has received approval of its Environmental Impact Assessment from Thailand's Office of Natural Resources and Environmental Policy and Planning, and construction is now under way.

Rising along the waterfront of Johor Bahru, this residence seamlessly combines international hospitality management, strategic connectivity and long-term value creation, offering discerning buyers not just a prestigious address to live in, but a resilient home for the future.
ADVERTISEMENT Set within the visionary Lido Waterfront Boulevard master plan, Skypark Kepler is a landmark in the making, designed to anchor JB’s next chapter as a global waterfront city.

Johor Bahru’s first Banyan Group-branded residence What sets Skypark Kepler apart is its distinction as JB’s first branded residence managed by the Banyan Group, a globally-recognised hospitality brand known for luxury and wellness-led experiences.
A new benchmark in curated waterfront living, elevates residential expectations in Johor Bahru under world-class management.
Banyan Group introduces hotel-grade management standards and lifestyle curation into the residential environment.

For homeowners and investors, this means a home shaped around comfort, convenience and everyday living, apart from professional management consistency, stronger tenant appeal, and brand-backed positioning in a competitive high-rise market.

A strategic waterfront address with cross-border connectivity Strategically located in JB’s southern corridor, Skypark Kepler sits within 10km of the Johor– Singapore Causeway, and the upcoming Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link at Bukit Chagar.
Once operational, the RTS will integrate directly with Singapore’s MRT network, significantly improving daily cross-border mobility.
An elevated residents’ lounge with panoramic views is designed for refined gatherings and moments of quiet retreat.
Connectivity is further supported by access to the Coastal Highway, Tebrau Highway, and the Eastern Dispersal Link (EDL), strengthening regional accessibility.
This positioning broadens its appeal to local owner-occupiers, cross-border professionals, and international investors alike, each drawn to its connectivity-driven value.
International zoning with enhanced ownership flexibility Skypark Kepler benefits from International Zoning, allowing up to 95% foreign ownership — compared to the standard 40% allocation.
The foreign purchase threshold of RM400,000 is also notably lower than Johor’s typical RM1 million requirement.
This structure enhances accessibility for overseas buyers while supporting liquidity over the longer term.
A fully-furnished unit enhanced with Samsung appliances and integrated smart features is designed for effortless modern living.
Scale within a larger seafront vision Developed on a 3.97-acre freehold site, Skypark Kepler comprises two 54-storey towers with a total of 1,596 branded residences.
The estimated gross development value of approximately RM1.42 billion reflects the project’s scale.
The development forms part of a broader mixed-use master plan integrating residential, commercial, wellness, education, cultural, and recreational components.
Such integration mitigates the isolation risk often associated with standalone high-rise developments.
Designed for modern urban demand Skypark Kepler offers three residential configurations ranging from 463-sq ft one-bedroom units to 807-sq ft three-bedroom layouts.
The sizing reflects efficiency-driven urban homeowner preferences and rental-friendly formats.
Residences are planned with functional layouts, and views of the waterfront and city skyline.
Prices range approximately RM522,000– RM1.217 million, positioning the development within the premium segment while remaining comparatively accessible relative to Singapore benchmarks.
An infinity pool aligns with the waterfront, offering open skies, layered landscapes, and uninterrupted views.

Resort-style facilities under branded management The development features 43 facilities across a dedicated amenities level, including swimming pools, wellness spaces, landscaped gardens, and communal lounges.
All facilities are managed to international hospitality standards under the Banyan Group brand.
Residents also benefit from access to a 2.5km coastal boardwalk and a 32-acre green park, extending the living environment beyond vertical residential space.

Positioned within a transforming coastal district Skypark Kepler rises along JB’s waterfront as part of the wider Lido Friendship City vision, which seeks to integrate residential, business, and lifestyle components within a sustainable coastal precinct.

— the developer behind the award-winning Le Condé BKK1 Phase 1.
The project occupies a 1,736 sqm corner plot at Street 63 and Street 352 in BKK1, Phnom Penh's most prestigious residential and diplomatic district.
Pre-booking opened March 18, 2026, with completion targeted for 2029.

The building delivers 398 fully furnished residences across four culturally inspired collections: Romdoul (Floors 8–16), Angkor (Floors 18–31), Preah Vihear (Floors 33–50), and Devaraja (Floors 52–61), ranging from 1-bedroom apartments (73 sqm gross) to 5-bedroom penthouses (369 sqm gross).
All units feature 3.2-metre ceilings (3.5m in penthouses), floor-to-ceiling windows, island kitchens, and Xiaomi smart home technology.
The developer is backed by Beijing Zhongguancun Construction Co., Ltd.
(market value ~USD 1.15 billion) with construction support from Sichuan Huaxi Group.
Le Condé BKK1 Phase 1 received three Cambodia Real Estate Awards in 2023, including best project recognition, and introduced Xiaomi smart home integration as a first in Cambodia.
Phase 2 builds directly on this reputation, targeting the same premium buyer and tenant demographic at an address that benefits from embassy proximity, BKK1's international schools, and AEON Mall 1.

The development provides over 8,000 sqm of facilities across multiple levels including a 240-metre sky jogging track, a 1,000 sqm sky garden on the 32nd floor, rooftop infinity pool, sky bar on the 44th floor, children's paradise on the 15th floor, digital golf club, co-working space, on-site supermarket, and full wellness suite including steam, sauna, and jacuzzi.
Pricing starts at USD 158,056 for a 1-bedroom unit, placing the development at approximately USD 2,156–2,424/sqm — competitive within BKK1's luxury segment.

Construction of the 220-unit apartment block is already under way, after the UAE-headquartered master developer awarded AED2 billion worth of contracts to build 14 residential buildings earlier this year.
The Gate 6 comprises a selection of premium one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom residences, with prices starting from AED970,000.
Buyers can secure units for a down payment of just 5%, followed by 30% instalments over two years and 65% on completion.
All apartments within the complex will include smart home features as standard, as well as high-end, European-manufactured appliances such as kitchen cookers, hoods and washer-dryers.
The complex will feature a range of high-quality facilities, including an indoor gym and a variety of retail, healthcare and dining options.
Residents will also have exclusive access to both adults’ and children’s swimming pools, as well as an outdoor gym space, playground and table tennis area.

Located near the megacommunity’s northwest corner, The Gate 6 sits alongside Raffles World Academy, Aljada – a new K-12 school offering both the International Baccalaureate (IB) curriculum and the US High School Diploma.
This state-of-the-art, 2,000-student campus is due to open in time for the 2026-2027 academic year.
Sharjah’s real estate market has enjoyed a robust start to 2026, and demand for premium property remains strong.
More than 7,000 transactions were recorded during Ramadan this year, totalling AED4.6 billion.
This represents a 72% year-on-year rise in overall value compared to the corresponding period of 2025.
Aljada spans 24 million square feet and features more than 25,000 homes, as well as extensive retail, sports, wellness, hospitality, office and education amenities.
Already home to 20,000 people, the community is located within minutes of Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road, Al Dhaid Road and Sharjah International Airport.

from $300,500 Villas from $650,200 Description Luma Residence is a 240-home neighbourhood inside Muscat Bay , the resort community set in the bay at Bandar Jissah, south-east of Muscat.

It mixes three products on one site — 156 apartments in low-rise buildings, 52 townhouses and 32 villas — in creamy render, wood-textured stone and tinted-glass balustrades, stepped into a valley between the Hajar mountains and the sea.
Two features are central to the offer.
The first is the payment plan: 50% of the price falls due on completion , and the booking deposit is 2.5% .
The second is the price ladder — villas start at $650,200 and townhouses at $568,400 , both above Oman’s OMR 200,000 residency threshold, while the $300,500 apartments are below it.
This guide works through sizes, prices, the eight instalments, service charges and the developer.
Luma Residence at a glance Location Bandar Jissah, inside Muscat Bay, Muscat Developer Saraya Bandar Jissah — now trading as Muscat Bay (est.

2007) Ownership Freehold, open to all nationalities Total homes 240 — 156 apartments, 52 townhouses, 32 villas Currently available 43 — about 82% of the scheme is already taken Size range 1,137 – 3,226 sq ft (106 – 300 m²) Apartments from $300,500 Townhouses from $568,400 Villas from $650,200 Service charge 8.27 OMR per m² per year (apartments); 6.27 OMR per m² per year (villas) Payment plan 8 instalments; 50% before handover Airport Muscat International — 35 minutes Handover Q1 2029 (per the sales material) Sizes and prices Home type Size from Price from Per sq ft Count Apartment, 2-bedroom 1,211 sq ft (113 m²) $300,500 $248 156 Townhouse 2,607 sq ft (242 m²) $568,400 $218 52 Villa, 3-bedroom 2,997 sq ft (278 m²) $650,200 $217 32 Home of 3,226 sq ft 3,226 sq ft (300 m²) On request — — At Luma the price per square foot falls as the home gets larger.
The apartment is priced at $248 per square foot and the villa at $217 — a 13% difference.
This is the reverse of Golf Hills , where the three-bedroom costs 20% more per foot than the one-bedroom.
The reason is that you are not buying the same thing.
The apartment price carries a share of lift cores, lobbies, the clubhouse and the shared pool.
The villa price is weighted towards land, a private plot, its own pool and two covered parking bays — and land inside an operating resort community prices differently from built floor area.
Measured strictly in dollars per square foot, the villas and townhouses are priced at $217 and $218 against $248 for the apartments.
Reading the unit table: home by home The sizes and prices table gives one entry point for each home type, and reading the rows side by side shows how the scheme is organised.
The two-bedroom apartment starts at 1,211 sq ft (113 m²) and $300,500, which is $248 per square foot.
The townhouse starts at 2,607 sq ft (242 m²) and $568,400, or $218 per square foot.
The three-bedroom villa starts at 2,997 sq ft (278 m²) and $650,200, or $217 per square foot.
The scheme as a whole spans 1,137 to 3,226 sq ft (106 to 300 m²), and the 3,226 sq ft home is priced on request.
Moving from the apartment to the townhouse adds 1,396 sq ft of floor area and $267,900 to the entry price.
Moving from the townhouse to the villa adds a further 390 sq ft (36 m²) and $81,800.
Divided by the listed area in square metres, the entry prices work out to roughly $2,659 per m² for the apartment, $2,349 for the townhouse and $2,339 for the villa.
The payment plan: 50% held to handover This is the main payment term at Luma Residence.
The plan runs to eight instalments and blends calendar dates with construction milestones — but the structure is dominated by one number.

# Trigger Type Share 1 On booking Date 2.5% 2 15 days after booking — signing the sale agreement Date 7.5% 3 6 months after booking Date 5% 4 12 months after booking Date 5% 5 Substructure complete Milestone 10% 6 Superstructure works complete Milestone 10% 7 Engineering systems complete Milestone 10% 8 On completion and handover Milestone 50% Total Before handover: 50% — 100% Three consequences follow, and they are worth stating plainly.
Half the price is paid before handover.
On an apartment you will have paid $150,250 by handover; on a villa, $325,100.
The booking deposit is 2.5%.
2.5% is $7,513 on an apartment.
You need half the money ready in Q1 2029.
The plan places a large single payment at the end.
If you intend to use a mortgage, start that conversation early.
Our guide to buying off-plan in Oman covers the escrow and staged-payment mechanics.

Grouping the eight payments by their trigger shows the shape of the plan.
The four date-based payments (2.5% on booking, 7.5% at signing, and 5% at six and at twelve months) add up to 20% of the price.
The three construction milestones add 30%, and the completion payment is the remaining 50%.
For the $300,500 apartment, the date-based payments total $60,100 over the first twelve months: $7,513 at booking, $22,538 at signing and $15,025 at each of the two later dates.
The three milestone payments of $30,050 add $90,150, which brings the total before handover to $150,250, and the same $150,250 is due on completion.
For the $650,200 villa the date-based payments total $130,040 and the milestones add $195,060, so each half comes to $325,100.
These figures are illustrative and use the prices listed on this page; the payment schedule in the sale agreement is the binding record.
In rial terms, the apartment’s completion payment of $150,250 is about OMR 57,800 at the peg of OMR 1 = USD 2.6008.
Residency: prices against the OMR 200,000 threshold Oman’s property-linked residency routes turn on investment thresholds.

Golden Residency requires a single ITC property worth at least OMR 200,000 — roughly $520,000 at the rial’s long-standing dollar peg — and is decided by the Royal Oman Police; the Owner Visa has no minimum.

Prices at Luma sit on both sides of that level within the same development : Home type Entry price Against the ~$520,000 mark Villa $650,200 At or above the mark Townhouse $568,400 At or above the mark Apartment $300,500 Below the mark The townhouse, from $568,400, is priced at or above the threshold with a margin rather than sitting exactly on the line.
The apartments are priced below OMR 200,000.

From reservation to keys: the process in more detail A purchase at Luma follows the usual off-plan sequence: Reservation.
The buyer selects a home from the live availability list and pays the 2.5% booking deposit.

Sale and purchase agreement (SPA).

Escrow account.
Reservation documents normally name the bank, the account holder and the project escrow account into which instalments are paid.
Royal Decree 79/2025, issued on 10 September 2025, promulgated Oman’s new law regulating real estate, and the reservation documents state the escrow arrangements that apply to each buyer’s payments.

Handover and snagging.
On completion the final 50% falls due and the home is handed over; per the developer, the target is Q1 2029.
At handover the buyer inspects the home and lists any finishing points for the developer to complete, which is known as snagging.
Electricity and water accounts are then set up with the providers.

Frequently asked questions Where is Luma Residence?
In Bandar Jissah, inside the Muscat Bay resort community south-east of Muscat — 6 minutes from Qantab Beach, about 25 minutes from the city and 35 minutes from Muscat International Airport.
Can foreigners buy at Luma Residence?
Yes.
Homes are sold freehold and are open to buyers of any nationality, with title registered in the purchaser’s name.
Muscat Bay is an Integrated Tourism Complex, the designation that permits foreign freehold ownership in Oman.
How much does a home cost?
Apartments start at $300,500 from 1,211 sq ft, townhouses at $568,400 from 2,607 sq ft, and villas at $650,200 from 2,997 sq ft.
The scheme’s homes run up to 3,226 sq ft.
What is the payment plan?

Eight instalments: 2.5% on booking, 7.5% at signing 15 days later, 5% at 6 months, 5% at 12 months, then 10% each at substructure, superstructure and engineering-systems completion, and 50% on completion .
What are the service charges?
8.27 OMR per m² per year for apartments and 6.27 OMR per m² per year for villas — roughly 930 OMR (about $2,419) on a 1,211 sq ft apartment and 1,746 OMR (about $4,540) on a 2,997 sq ft villa.
When does Luma Residence complete?
Q1 2029, according to the sales material.
How many homes are there?
240 in total — 156 apartments, 52 townhouses and 32 villas.
About 43 remain available.
Do the villas have private pools?
Villa pools are specified with a pearl-white mosaic tile finish, and villa and townhouse terraces are laid in WPC composite decking.
Is parking included?
Villas get a canopy for two cars and townhouses a canopy for one.
Apartments have open-air parking in front of the buildings, not covered bays.
Are the homes furnished?

Not furnished, but finished — wood-textured porcelain floors, painted walls and gypsum ceilings, a wood-effect accent wall, matte charcoal kitchen cabinetry and grey porcelain bathrooms with oak-veneer vanities.
Does buying here qualify for Omani residency?
Golden Residency requires a single ITC property worth at least OMR 200,000 (about $520,000) and is decided by the Royal Oman Police; the Owner Visa has no minimum.
Villas at $650,200 and townhouses at $568,400 are above that level; the $300,500 apartments are below it.
See our guide to Golden Residency and the Owner Visa .
Who is the developer?
Saraya Bandar Jissah, now trading as Muscat Bay — an Omani company founded in 2007 as a partnership between the state tourism group OMRAN and Saraya Oman.
It developed and operates the surrounding Muscat Bay community.
How much of the price is paid in the first twelve months?
20%: 2.5% on booking, 7.5% at signing, and 5% each at six and twelve months.
On the $300,500 apartment that is $60,100, and on the $650,200 villa $130,040.
How is the service charge calculated?
The rate (8.27 OMR per m² per year for apartments, 6.27 for villas) is multiplied by the home’s area in square metres.
The 113 m² apartment comes to about 930 OMR a year and the 278 m² villa to about 1,746 OMR.
In which currency are payments made?
Prices are quoted in US dollars and settled in Omani rials at the long-standing peg of OMR 1 = USD 2.6008, so a buyer paying in another currency converts each instalment.
Who develops the neighbouring projects?
Zen Residences, inside Muscat Bay, is developed by Zen Development and Investment, and Al Mina belongs to the neighbouring Barr Al Jissah resort.
