The architecture is defined by transparency, light, and elegant geometry, transforming panoramic city views into an integral part of everyday life.

Designed as a serene sanctuary within a vibrant creative hub, the project seamlessly merges artistic energy with residential calm, offering uninterrupted vistas of the Dubai skyline, waterfront, and iconic landmarks.
Beyond its architectural presence, Artistry One Residences delivers a lifestyle shaped by wellness, connection, and elevated leisure.

Residents enjoy a curated collection of amenities distributed across multiple levels, including a skyline-facing swimming pool, sun decks, family lawns, children’s play areas, residents’ lounge, co-working spaces, and social pavilions.

Higher levels feature an infinity lap pool with panoramic views, a state-of-the-art fitness suite, private training studio, sauna, steam room, and ice baths, creating a holistic environment where wellbeing, recreation, and community coexist effortlessly.
The residences at Artistry One Residences include a curated selection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, along with exclusive four-bedroom duplex penthouses.
Homes feature generous ceiling heights, refined layouts with select units offering maid’s rooms, and thoughtfully allocated parking.

Interiors are finished with porcelain and timber flooring, contemporary bathrooms with brushed nickel fittings and tempered glass, and modern kitchens with reconstructed stone countertops and solid timber cabinetry.

Apartments are equipped with Teka kitchen appliances, while the duplex penthouses elevate the experience with dual private entrances, plunge pools, expansive terraces, studies, and fully integrated front- and back-of-house kitchens featuring premium Miele appliances in the main kitchen and Teka appliances in service areas, delivering a sophisticated balance of functionality, comfort, and refined urban luxury.
Location description and benefits Dubai Design District (d3) is a vibrant hub where creativity, innovation, and culture converge.
Purposefully envisioned as a global destination for design, fashion, art, and technology, d3 nurtures a community of forward-thinkers and creators.
Its carefully curated environment brings together local and international talent, fostering collaboration and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in the creative industries.
Designed with a holistic lifestyle in mind, d3 seamlessly blends residential, commercial, and public spaces.
Walkable promenades, cycling paths, and immersive art installations create a dynamic and engaging atmosphere.
From waterfront residences to lush green zones and curated experiences, every aspect of the district is intended to enhance both individual well-being and community connection.
Spanning over 18 million square feet, d3 offers a unique urban experience rooted in inspiration and expression.

Its architectural identity and community-first ethos celebrate the intersection of design and daily life, making it not just a place to live or work — but a destination where creativity lives, grows, and thrives.

Lo que hace apenas unos años era una zona discreta al norte del Parque Selwo, en Estepona , se está convirtiendo a marchas forzadas en la nueva referencia residencial de la costa, y los grandes promotores no están perdiendo el tren.
Neinor Homes acaba de lanzar Australy Thera , el tercer y último proyecto de su complejo Australy, con 42 viviendas en segunda fase y vistas al mar, Gibraltar y la montaña como carta de presentación.
Sigue a idealista/news en el canal de Whatsapp Publicidad El movimiento no es menor.

Con Thera, Neinor cierra un desarrollo que suma casi 200 viviendas en un enclave que la propia industria ya bautiza como el triángulo de oro que forman Estepona, Marbella y Benahavís y que pugna por arrebatarle protagonismo a zonas históricamente más consolidadas de la costa.
Las ventas de la primera fase ya alcanzan el 50% , señal de que el mercado -nacional, pero sobre todo internacional- está respondiendo.
En concreto, Australy se encuentra a pocos minutos de la playa y cuenta con excelentes comunicaciones como la conexión, a través de la A-7, con puntos emblemáticos como Puerto Banús o Sotogrande .

Tercer proyecto Australy Thera representa el tercer proyecto en este ámbito, un complejo residencial que cuenta, además, con una exclusiva Casa Club Social con spa , piscina exterior, gimnasio, gastrobar y coworking para uso de los residentes.
Australy estará formado por tres promociones: Libella, ya entregada; Aures, con entrega próxima; y ahora Thera.
En total, Neinor Homes desarrollará cerca de 200 viviendas en este nuevo barrio de Estepona.

La promoción acogerá 67 amplias viviendas en total -25 en primera fase y 42 en segunda- de 2, 3 y 4 dormitorios (incluidos dúplex de tres dormitorios como tipología especial) con garaje y trastero y zonas ajardinadas.

Las generosas superficies de los inmuebles, a partir de 113 m2 , se reflejan en espacios como el salón-cocina-comedor abiertos y orientados hacia una gran terraza con vistas al mar y a la montaña; y también en el dormitorio principal, con baño en suite y grandes vestidores.
"Las viviendas se caracterizan por sus amplias superficies con una óptima distribución, que permite diferenciar la zona de día de la zona de noche, y también por una ventilación natural cruzada.

Otra de las ventajas del proyecto es su buena ubicación pues todo Australy, y en concreto Thera, se encuentra en una zona privilegiada de Estepona que está experimentando una espectacular transformación, un enclave perfecto para quienes buscan calidad de vida sin renunciar a la cercanía al mar", explica la promotora en una nota de prensa.

Primera y segunda residencia e inversión La comercialización de Australy Thera, así como la de Libella y Aures, "va viento en popa", según señala Neinor, atrayendo a un cliente nacional y sobre todo internacional que busca obra nueva y que, fundamentalmente, desea una segunda residencia en una localización única como Estepona.
Las ventas de la primera fase del proyecto ya alcanzan el 50%.

Tropika is a large-scale condominium development situated in Choeng Thale, one of Phuket's most sought-after residential corridors on the island's prestigious west coast.
Located just 1.2 kilometers from Bang Tao Beach, the project comprises 616 units across four buildings rising seven floors each, with completion scheduled for Q4 2028.

Unit configurations range from compact 30-square-meter studios to expansive 190-square-meter duplexes, with prices starting at $132,000 and extending to $737,000, translating to approximately $4,286 to $4,943 per square meter — competitive positioning within the established Bang Tao corridor.

The development is distinguished by its partnership with Wyndham, one of the world's largest hospitality groups, which provides professional hotel-standard management and access to a global booking network with millions of loyalty program members.

This institutional-grade operator involvement elevates VIP Tropika beyond a typical residential project, positioning it as a credible hospitality investment with built-in demand channels and professional revenue management.

Buyers benefit from a 6% guaranteed return over three years, offering predictable income during the initial post-completion period while the property establishes its market presence within the Bang Tao hospitality ecosystem and builds its reputation across international booking platforms.
The surrounding area features Villa Market, Boat Avenue lifestyle mall, and the comprehensive Laguna Phuket resort complex within a short drive.

VIP Tropika delivers a resort-lifestyle experience with comprehensive communal facilities designed for both residents and short-stay guests, including a main swimming pool with island feature, a rooftop pool, fitness centre, and conference facilities.
The Choeng Thale location places owners within easy reach of Bang Tao's upscale dining, Boat Avenue lifestyle mall, and the Laguna Phuket integrated resort complex.

For investors seeking exposure to Phuket's west coast tourism corridor at a competitive per-square-meter rate, VIP Tropika presents a compelling value proposition backed by institutional management and a developer with eight completed projects across the island.

Thailand allows foreign freehold ownership of condominiums up to 49% of a project's total unit area.
For landed property, foreigners typically use long-term leasehold agreements.
All foreign currency for purchases must be remitted from overseas.
That is the national position; we have not recorded building-specific terms for VIP Tropika, so confirm them for this development before relying on them.

Buyers should also note: Foreign Freehold limited to condominiums registered under the Condominium Act and funds must be transferred from overseas in foreign currency with Foreign Exchange Transaction Form.
Is VIP Tropika completed, and when can I move in?
VIP Tropika is currently off plan.
Completion is scheduled for Q4 2028.
Off-plan timelines slip, so ask for the developer's track record on delivery dates and check what protection the payment schedule gives you if it does.
What unit types are available at VIP Tropika?
5 unit types are listed at VIP Tropika, ranging from 1 to 3 bedrooms, between 30 and 139 sqm.
Listed prices run from THB 4,620,000 to THB 25,800,000.
Availability moves, so the current release is worth confirming before you plan around a specific layout.
Who is the developer behind VIP Tropika?
VIP Tropika is developed by VIP Thailand (VIP Property Development Co., Ltd.), founded in 2015 and 8 projects completed.
Our assessment of their financial standing is good.
Developer track record is the single most useful thing to check on an off-plan purchase, and we are happy to go through it with you.
What should I check before buying at VIP Tropika?

The issues most worth checking here are: Using nominee Thai shareholders to circumvent foreign ownership limits is illegal, Not verifying the 49% foreign quota before purchasing a condo unit and failing to transfer purchase funds from abroad in foreign currency for freehold registration.
None of these is a reason not to buy, but each is something a buyer should have answered in writing before committing.

The developer's positioning targets the value-conscious investor segment without compromising on resort-level amenities or professional management.

The concept borrows the rhythm of waves and the calm of water, aiming for a resort-like mood while keeping a clean, international look suited to Pattaya’s tourism market.
The architectural language emphasizes openness and natural light.
Large openings and semi-outdoor transition spaces are used to invite sea breezes and support cross-ventilation - a practical response for a coastal condominium where humidity can be a real concern.

The palette leans toward sand-tones and soft stone-like finishes, with reflective surfaces that subtly echo water shimmer, helping the project stand out among high-rise condos in the broader Jomtien area.
Common areas are planned as a sequence of experiences: from a lobby with long visual depth to relaxation zones that connect with pool and landscaped greenery.
Functions are zoned to improve privacy and reduce crowding, supporting both end-users and rental demand.

Located on Soi Boonkanjana, the project benefits from convenient connections between Jomtien Beach and central Pattaya, reinforcing a design concept that balances lifestyle appeal with investment practicality.
Project Highlights Aquarous Jomtien Pattaya is located on Soi Boonkanjana in the Jomtien area, a pocket that balances a relaxed resort atmosphere with convenient access to Pattaya’s city zones.
This positioning suits both end-users and investors targeting long-stay tenants, including expats and lifestyle travelers.

The neighborhood is surrounded by multiple lifestyle condominium projects such as The Riviera Ocean Drive and Copacabana Beach Jomtien, reflecting sustained demand and an active residential market in Jomtien.
Jomtien- Boonkanjana location Close to everyday dining, services, and local amenities while maintaining more privacy than main roads, supporting comfortable long-term living.
Connectivity Easy access to Jomtien Second Road and Sukhumvit Road, enabling efficient drives to Central Pattaya, Naklua, and onward routes toward Sriracha and Bangkok.
Facilities for real use Designed with resort-style daily functionality in mind, supporting both leisure days and work-from-home routines, which can strengthen rental appeal.
Investor angle Jomtien attracts a broad tenant base with steady short- to mid-term demand, improving cashflow potential and liquidity in Pattaya’s resort-condo segment.
Description Aquarous Jomtien Pattaya is a high-rise condominium located at 188 Soi Boon Kanjana, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung, Chonburi 20150.

The project sits in the Jomtien area with convenient access to Jomtien Beach, making it suitable for residential living, holiday homes, and rental investment in one of Thailand’s key tourist destinations.
The development is planned as 1 high-rise residential tower of 44 floors with approximately 606 units.
Parking is expected at around 30 - 35% of total units.
Unit types include 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, and penthouse layouts, with a design focus on sea views and comfortable living space.
Facilities include a lobby, swimming pool, fitness center, shared relaxation areas, sky garden, multipurpose room, and family-oriented common spaces.
Security features include 24-hour security personnel, CCTV, and controlled access entry systems.
The project is expected to be completed around 2027 and is developed by AssetWise Public Company Limited.
As of the current launch period, formal information regarding juristic management has not been clearly announced.
The surrounding area offers access to Jomtien Second Road, Sukhumvit Road, restaurants, cafes, local markets, and beachside attractions.
A nearby project in the same area is The Riviera Ocean Drive , reflecting the continued growth potential of Jomtien as a resort condominium and long-term investment location.

This keeps resale pricing disciplined, while long-stay demand from Pattaya-based professionals and foreign tenants supports annual leases.

No pets are allowed at The Boon Condo unless specifically permitted by the juristic office.
Exceptions can be made for service or guide dogs for persons with disabilities.
What and how far away is the nearest Beach from The Boon Condo?
Chaweng Beach is the nearest Beach from The Boon Condo and it is 3.8 km away.
How can foreigners own condos in Thailand?
Foreigners can own a condominium Freehold in their own name.
Condominium ownership is best explained by looking at an example of a project that has 100 units for sale.
In this example, 49 of the total units in this building (or 49% of the total salable area) can be owned outright by non-thai nationals in their name.
The ownership titles of these 49 units is referred to as Freehold or Foreign Quota.
This leaves 51 units remaining in the building (or 51% of the total salable).
The freehold rights to these units are reserved for Thai nationals in what is commonly referred to as the Thai quota.
What is the process of a property purchase in Thailand?

After you have found the right property, you have to follow these steps: - Agreement of terms and conditions - Reservation Agreement - Reservation Deposit - Sales and Purchase Agreement - Settlement & Transfer Payment Schedule Installment Milestone Payment Reservation Deposit Upon contract signing 10% 1st Installment Construction Start Foundations 30% 2nd Installment Structural & Concrete Works Complete 30% 3rd Installment MEP Systems Installed 10% 4th Installment Doors & Window Installation 10% 5th Installment Finishing Works 5% 6th Installment On handover 5% Can I purchase and transfer a property in my name from being outside the country (Thailand)?

What type of visa can I get?
Thailand has different visas like Spousal Visa, Retirement Visa, Student Visa and Elite Visa - just to name a few options.
Each visa has different requirements, but they are usually easy to obtain.

The development offers a range of key advantages: convenient location; excellent transport accessibility; on-site infrastructure; landscaped and well-maintained grounds; high level of security; use of energy-efficient building materials; stylish, contemporary architecture; panoramic terrace; smart and functional layouts; high-quality finishes; trusted and reliable developer.
Prime location m² Highlight is situated in Tbilisi’s Dighomi district, an area known for its well-developed social and commercial infrastructure.
Excellent road connections make it easy to reach the city center and other neighborhoods.
Positioned along the Mtkvari River embankment, the complex offers beautiful views from every apartment.
With no industrial facilities nearby, the area enjoys clean air and a pleasant environment.
Surrounding amenities The complex is surrounded by a wide range of commercial, retail, and social amenities—all within walking distance—including: educational institutions: public schools No.
4, No.

158, Projector School, and a kindergarten; medical services: Medi Comfort Clinic Digomi, Evex Clinics, Central Republican Hospital, and pharmacies; shopping: Agrohub hypermarket, Bricorama home goods store, Bellona furniture store, Madagoni supermarket, and a pet store; dining options: Wendy’s Drive Thru, Dunkin’, Megrelebi (Georgian cuisine), and Old Town restaurant; leisure and recreation: Villa.Stage concert venue, 10a Korp sports complex, football fields, children’s playgrounds, Mini Football Field “Parki,” and the Mayakovsky monument; hotels and guesthouses; bank branches and post offices; gas stations; and many other conveniences.
Architecture m² Highlight stands out as one of Tbilisi’s most impressive architectural developments.
The project includes two high-rise towers—26 and 36 stories—connected by a shared podium, and is built to meet international construction standards.
The buildings are being constructed using a monolithic frame system designed for seismic safety, with high-quality materials that ensure both energy efficiency and long-term durability.
The complex features a sleek, modern design, with rounded corners and smooth vertical façades that give it a futuristic look.
Panoramic windows and open balconies are seamlessly integrated into the architecture.
The podium is wrapped in glass and topped with a usable rooftop area.
The buildings are equipped with state-of-the-art utilities and a modern fire safety system.
Entrances and common areas are designed to be fully accessible for people with limited mobility.
On-site infrastructure The complex offers a multifunctional infrastructure designed to suit the needs and lifestyles of a diverse community.
The ground floors feature office and retail spaces that will house a variety of shops, cafes, and entertainment venues, as well as co-working areas.
Landscaped terraces and courtyard spaces are located on the podium roof, creating a welcoming environment for residents.
The courtyards are enhanced with greenery and offer leisure areas, sports zones, and playgrounds for children.
Residents can also enjoy relaxing spots for downtime and socializing.
Secure underground parking is available, with elevator access directly to all residential floors.
The lobbies and shared spaces reflect the overall design aesthetic of the complex and are fitted with high-speed passenger elevators.
Transport accessibility m² Highlight enjoys a prime location between two major thoroughfares—Marshal Gelovani Avenue and Akaki Bakradze Street—offering excellent transport links.
A public transport stop is just a one-minute walk from the complex and connects to numerous bus routes serving all parts of the city.
Grigol Robakidze Bridge (leading to the left bank of Tbilisi), the central railway station, and the Didube bus terminal are just four minutes away by car.
Tbilisi International Airport is a 30-minute drive.
Apartments The complex offers a selection of spacious 1- and 2-bedroom apartments, ranging from 68.98 to 141.62 m².
All units feature smart, functional layouts with well-proportioned rooms, high ceilings, wide balconies or terraces, and stunning panoramic views of the Kura River and cityscape.
Apartments are delivered in a “white frame” finish, with utilities fully connected, internet cabling in place, and central heating installed.
About the developer m² , a subsidiary of the investment holding Georgia Capital , is the developer behind this residential project.
Since entering Georgia’s real estate market in 2006, m² has focused on building affordable, energy-efficient homes.
The company has a strong track record, with over 16 real estate projects at various stages of development.
To learn more about m² Highlight and view current apartment prices, visit the developer’s official website.

The guarantee runs for the first three years from the official start of rental operations.

Ask for the letting contract and the management fee before you count the 4.2% as income.
Two conditions apply: the residence must be bought off-plan together with the turn-key upgrade package, which is the furniture, quoted per unit and not optional if you are buying for the yield.
Eligibility and the exact figure are confirmed per unit at reservation.
Returns are guaranteed for the first 3 years; treat anything past the guaranteed term as Tivat's tourism curve, not a fixed return.

Boka Verde - frequently asked questions How much does an apartment at Boka Verde cost?

Can you please briefly describe the process and timing of purchasing my property?
Please click here to review the Residential Property Sales Process.
Are there any restrictions in buying a residential property in The Ellinikon that arise from my country of origin?
No, there are no restrictions in buying a residential property in The Ellinikon associated to the purchaser’s country of origin.
Can I buy a property as an individual, or is it possible to purchase it through a legal entity?
Purchasers are free to choose how they wish to purchase their property, either as individuals or via a Greek or foreign legal entity.

The Purchaser can sign the Reservation Agreement either as individual or legal entity, in which case, the Sale & Purchase Agreement should be signed by the same physical/legal entity, or parent, child or spouse or a legal entity where the entity that signed the RA holds more than 50%.
Do I pay VAT when I purchase a residential property in The Ellinikon?
No, all purchases of residential properties in The Ellinikon are exempted from VAT until the 31/12/2026.
Can I apply for a Golden Visa when purchasing a property in The Ellinikon?
Yes, the buyer of a property in The Ellinikon can apply for a Golden Visa, according to the current legislation, where the minimum value of the property is €800,000.

How can foreigners own houses at Botanica Luxury Krabi?
The building (the bricks and mortar) can be owned by a non-Thai national outright in their name in what is called the house registry, which secures ownership indefinitely of the structure.
In Thailand, non-Thai nationals cannot own land outright in their name.
Land can be controlled through either a Thai Company or a long-term registered lease.
The longest registered lease term by Thai law is 30 years, and most developers will offer 3 terms for a total of 90 years.
How does Leasehold work - is it safe?
A 30-year lease period is legally protected under Thai law and ownership cannot be disrupted.
It is common for developers to offer an additional two terms of 30 contractually obligating a total of 90 years.
Prior to purchasing a leasehold property, it is important to secure a copy of the lease agreement or get further clarity on these three points: - Who is the lessor?
(an individual or a Thai Company) Securing a lease from a Thai Company offers much more security than a private individual.
- Do I have voting rights as a Lessee?
(Some lease contracts do not allow lessee to have voting rights) - Is there a succession clause in the lease agreement that will allow inheritance of the lease?

How can foreigners own condos in Thailand?
Foreigners can own a condominium Freehold in their own name.
Condominium ownership is best explained by looking at an example of a project that has 100 units for sale.
In this example, 49 of the total units in this building (or 49% of the total salable area) can be owned outright by non-thai nationals in their name.
The ownership titles of these 49 units is referred to as Freehold or Foreign Quota.
This leaves 51 units remaining in the building (or 51% of the total salable).
The freehold rights to these units are reserved for Thai nationals in what is commonly referred to as the Thai quota.
What is the process of a property purchase in Thailand?

The scheme is made up of two seven-storey buildings with 241 units, underground parking and a substantial common-area programme.

Gallery Units Why About At a glance Ownership format Facilities Location Nearby Price Who it suits What to check Not confirmed FAQ Sources Project verification Why this project is worth a look A genuinely broad unit mix The project spans compact studios around 29–30 sqm, one-bedroom homes up to 74.99 sqm, two-bedroom units up to 81.86 sqm and a 96.07 sqm three-bedroom layout.
That range supports several use cases inside one scheme rather than forcing every buyer into a small investment-style apartment.

Amenities built for long stays Three pools, fitness, spa and thermal facilities, a restaurant, co-working areas, children's space and security make AURA more self-contained than a basic residential block.
The trade-off is that the quality and cost of future common-area management become part of the ownership decision.
Construction-linked instalments Most of the purchase price is scheduled against construction milestones rather than being due immediately.
That can help with cash planning, but milestone payments only work well when the contract clearly defines progress, the final handover date and the buyer's remedies if the programme slips.
A workable foreign-title route As a registered condominium project, AURA can offer foreign freehold within Thailand's 49% foreign quota.
The structure is straightforward compared with land-based ownership, although quota availability still has to be checked for the exact unit at the time of transfer.
Residential south Phuket setting Soi Sermsuk sits in the Rawai-Chalong residential area, with schools, supermarkets and Chalong Pier closer than the main swimming beaches.
That can suit year-round residents and long-stay tenants better than buyers whose priority is stepping directly from the lobby onto the sand.
About the project AURA Condominium is an under-construction residential project on Soi Sermsuk in Rawai, southern Phuket.
The developer's current project page lists 22 layouts and targets completion in Q2 2028.

That matters because this is still an off-plan purchase: the apartment itself is only one part of the decision, alongside the sale contract, construction milestones, payment timing and the remedies available if handover moves again.
The project is mapped at 73 Soi Sermsuk, Rawai, Mueang Phuket, with the developer's map link resolving to 7.8149049, 98.3370922.
In practical terms, the setting belongs to the Rawai-Chalong residential corridor rather than a true beachfront strip.
Home In Phuket places International School of Phuket at roughly 350 metres and groups Villa Market Chalong, Makro Rawai, GO Wholesale Rawai and Chalong Pier within about two kilometres.
Its current project information puts Rawai Beach at about 6 km and Nai Harn Beach at about 8 km, so beach trips should be treated as a drive rather than an automatic walk from the building.
Read more Show less The scale is large enough to support a meaningful amenity package without becoming a high-rise complex.
Two low-rise buildings and 241 apartments create a different living proposition from either a boutique condo of a few dozen units or a dense tower.
Units are presented as finished and furnished, with appliances included.

That can simplify handover for an owner who wants a usable home without a separate fit-out project, but the commercial description is not a substitute for a contract schedule that names the actual furniture, appliances, finishes and specifications included with the selected unit.
The unit mix is broader than the entry price might suggest.
Studios run from 29.23 to 30.46 sqm.
One-bedroom units range from 36.85 to 74.99 sqm, two-bedroom homes from 50.44 to 81.86 sqm, and the three-bedroom configuration is 96.07 sqm.

The unusually wide one-bedroom band is particularly important: a compact unit in the high-thirties and a unit approaching 75 sqm are not interchangeable products even though both carry the same bedroom label.
Buyers should compare actual layout efficiency, storage, balcony size, orientation and usable living zones rather than buying by bedroom count alone.
Selected apartments are promoted with sea views, and some positions have direct pool access.
Those are unit-specific attributes, not project-wide guarantees.
The same caution applies to pets.

Recent third-party material refers to a limited pool of pet-friendly residences, while FazWaz states that pets are generally not allowed unless specifically permitted by the condominium juristic office.

Anyone buying with a pet should obtain written confirmation tied to the exact unit and the future condominium rules instead of assuming that a marketing reference will survive into the registered house rules.
The amenity programme is one of the more distinctive parts of AURA.

Current project information consistently shows three swimming pools, a gym, spa facilities, sauna and steam areas, a restaurant, co-working space, lobby, children's facilities, parking, lifts, 24-hour security and CCTV.
Several of the main shared facilities are placed on the first floor.
That mix can work well for long stays and remote work, but a fuller amenity package also creates a real operating budget.
The useful question is therefore not just whether the project has a spa or several pools, but what owners will pay to operate and maintain them once the condominium is handed over.

Current project listings show a common-area management charge of THB 60 per sqm per month and a one-off sinking-fund contribution of THB 800 per sqm, with the same figures repeated across more than one recent source.
We do not extrapolate those rates into an annual ownership bill because the final amount depends on the unit area, any advance-payment requirement and the executed sale documents.
A buyer should ask for a handover statement that sets out every payable item separately, including common fees, the sinking fund, registration-related charges and any other project-specific costs.
The published instalment schedule is milestone based.

It starts with a THB 150,000 reservation payment, then 35% after contract signing, 25% when the foundation is complete, 20% at construction completion, 15% after windows and doors are installed, and 5% at registration.
Staged payments reduce the amount paid upfront, but they are not a guarantee against delay.
The sale contract still needs objective milestone definitions, a long-stop handover date, a process for evidencing progress and clear consequences if the developer misses material obligations.

For an international buyer, the condominium structure provides an important legal route that villas and land do not: a foreign individual can own a qualifying condominium unit in their own name within the statutory foreign quota.
Thailand caps foreign ownership at 49% of the aggregate unit area of the condominium.
That quota is a live inventory constraint, not a permanent label on the project.
Aura listings also refer to leasehold alternatives.
Before paying a reservation, the buyer should have the tenure of the exact unit confirmed in writing together with the remaining foreign quota available for transfer.
Open-market pricing illustrates why unit-level verification matters.
The lowest listing found on 8 September 2026 was THB 2,914,560, while another current project inventory started around THB 3.032 million.
Different releases, floors, orientations, views, ownership structures and seller inventories can all produce different entry numbers.

A useful comparison therefore needs a unit number, floor, area, view, furnishing specification, tenure, instalment plan and complete transfer-cost sheet; a generic 'from' price on its own is too thin for a purchase decision.
Completion timing deserves special attention because the public record has moved.
The developer's current AURA page points to Q2 2028.
Another recent project page displays December 2028, a major portal continues to show June 2027, and older listings still contain 2026 or 2027 dates.

We use Q2 2028 in the project record because it is the freshest primary target, but buyers should treat the handover date in the current sale and purchase agreement as the legally relevant one and read any extension clauses carefully.
The developer identity is clear at brand level but deserves document-level checking.
AURA's official project page names THE ONE AURA CO., LTD as developer.

The ONE Group website places AURA in its portfolio and its footer identifies The One Phuket Co., Ltd as the company behind the group website; the group says it has been developing Phuket property since 2019.
Before funds move, the buyer should reconcile the project company, the contracting seller and the bank-account beneficiary.
A familiar brand name is useful context, but the enforceable obligations sit with the legal entity named in the transaction documents.

AURA therefore fits buyers who want a new low-rise condominium in southern Phuket, a wide spread of unit sizes and enough on-site facilities to support year-round use, and who are comfortable buying before completion.
It is a weaker fit for someone who needs immediate occupancy, a genuinely walk-to-the-beach address, or certainty that the completion schedule will not change again.

There is enough verified information here to compare the project seriously, but the final choice should be made on a specific unit and a current contract pack rather than on the general project presentation alone.
Ownership format Foreign buyers can register condominium freehold within the statutory foreign quota, capped at 49% of the aggregate unit area in the condominium.
Aura listings also offer leasehold in some cases; the remaining foreign quota and tenure of the exact unit should be confirmed before reservation.
Unit types & sizes Studio 29.23–30.46 sqm 1 bathroom The smallest format in the development and the natural entry point for a lower purchase budget.
Because the size spread is narrow, floor, orientation, outlook and position relative to pools and common areas matter more than a one-square-metre difference.
Current project stock starts around THB 3.03M, although individual market listings can sit below that level.

SouthMED The Real Mediterranean Overview A New Global Destination Rising on the Mediterranean An international designed fully integrated development spanning over an area of 23 million square meters of land.

Nestled in a very prime location on the Southern Mediterranean at the opulent Egyptian North Coast shoreline, SouthMED is perfectly situated at Kilo 165 on the Alexandria-Matrouh Road, offering easy accessibility, in addition to enjoying global proximity by flight distance of 2-5 hours from European and Gulf countries.
For added convenience, the Al Alamien International Airport is just an 18-minute drive away, ensuring seamless travel connections for residents and visitors alike.

Immerse yourself in the charm of the region and enjoy a world-class lifestyle, integrated amenities, unique beachfront activities, crystal swimmable lagoons, exquisite dining, breathtaking views, and many more.

Moncello Crest, Answered Directly.
Straight answers to the practical details of buying a Moncello Crest unit—from reservation and payment schedules to financing, documentation, and turnover.
General Location Investment General General Location Investment General How much is the reservation fee for Moncello Crest?
The reservation fee is ₱30,000 , credited toward the downpayment.
A parking slot is reserved separately for ₱10,000.
What documents do I need to reserve a unit?
Requirements depend on the buyer’s circumstances.
Local buyers typically provide two valid government-issued IDs, TIN, proof of billing address, and reservation-fee payment.
OFWs typically provide a valid passport, overseas employment contract or work permit, TIN, and an SPA when reserving remotely.
Foreign buyers are subject to applicable ownership rules and documentary requirements.
Project-specific requirements should be confirmed with the DMCI Sales Team.
When is my first monthly payment due after reservation?
Your first monthly payment typically begins 30 days after the reservation date .
The recurring due date follows the day you reserved: 1st–7th, every 7th; 8th–15th, every 15th; 16th–22nd, every 22nd; 23rd–30th/31st, every 30th, or the applicable February date.
DMCI sends payment reminders through SMS and email before each due date.
What are the payment terms?
Promo Terms or a 30% Regular Terms downpayment, paid through post-dated checks or auto-debit.
The Payment Calculator shows the exact schedule for any unit.
How is the balance financed?
After the downpayment, the balance can be paid through bank financing or DMCI in-house financing.
Current financing terms can be confirmed with the DMCI Sales Team.
When is turnover?
Blanca is targeted for November 2028 .
Ciela and Silva are targeted for August 2029 .
Location Where is Moncello Crest, and what is being built there?
A three-tower Modern Filipino leisure residence development by DMCI Homes (DHSUD License to Sell No.
0001243) on a 40,768 sqm site at Sitio Bato, via Bontiway, Brgy.
Poblacion, Tuba, Benguet, with Studio, 1BR, and 2BR residences across Blanca, Ciela, and Silva.
The Location tab in the Overview shows it on the map.
How far is Baguio City?
Baguio City center is about 7 km away via the Marcos Highway, with Burnham Park at 6.2 km and SM City Baguio at 6.6 km.
Which schools and hospitals are close?
Baguio General Hospital and Medical Center is about 5.5 km away and UP Baguio 6.1 km, with Saint Louis University and Notre Dame de Chartres Hospital both about 7.1 km.
What attractions are nearby?
Camp John Hay and BenCab Museum are about 8.0 km away, Wright Park 9.0 km, and Mines View Park 10.6 km.
How accessible is it by road?
It has direct access to the Aspiras-Palispis (Marcos) Highway, with Kennon Road nearby and Baguio Loakan Airport about 9.0 km away.
Investment How should I weigh value at Moncello Crest?
Less by price per square metre alone and more by the setting it gives you: a Modern Filipino retreat in the Benguet highlands with resort-oriented amenities.
For condotel units, the rental pool terms below also shape its value.
Insider Analysis still shows the current ₱/sqm for reference.
What is the current price range?
As of 2 Oct 2026 : ₱8.1M – ₱18.1M across 248 available Studio, 1BR and 2BR units.
It moves with live inventory; Availability & Pricing above has the current figures.
How do I estimate my payments?
Use the Payment Calculator .
For a quick estimate, choose a unit type and floor area to see the contract price, net downpayment, monthly DP, and balance to finance.
For a full breakdown, pick a specific Building Unit # and open its complete computation.
How does the rental pool program work?
Condotel units are enrolled in DMCI Homes’ Individual Rental Pool Program.
Units are fully furnished and managed by a hotel operator, while ownership stays with the buyer, and association dues are handled by the hotel operator.
What are the lease terms?
An initial period of 10 years, automatically renewed for another 10 years unless the unit owner rescinds.
Independent short-term leasing is not allowed.
How is rental income shared?
Room revenue is split 30% to unit owners, 5% to the condominium corporation for association dues and expenses, and 65% to the hotel operator for regular maintenance and upkeep.
Each owner’s income is the owners’ 30% share, less 5% withholding tax, divided in proportion to the unit’s gross floor area against the total condotel floor area.
Sample income projections are available from the DMCI Sales Team.
Do owners get complimentary stays?
Yes.
From turnover, owners receive annual complimentary room nights in points: 30 for a Studio, 33 for a 1BR, and 36 for a 2BR.
A night uses 1 point in a Studio, 1.5 in a 1BR, and 2 in a 2BR.
Points are transferable, may vary with the hotel’s occupancy, and can also be used at other DMCI Homes Leisure Residences properties such as Solmera Coast.
Who is Moncello Crest a good fit for?

Buyers who want a Modern Filipino leisure residence in the Benguet highlands, outside Baguio City but about 7 km from its center, and who are comfortable with a pre-selling timeline toward November 2028 (Blanca) or August 2029 (Ciela and Silva).
That applies to end-users and investors alike.
Who might be better suited elsewhere?
Buyers who need a unit before November 2028, want to live inside Baguio City itself, or are comparing mainly on ₱/sqm may want to compare Moncello Crest with other DMCI projects first.

Senna Tower is set to reach 544 metres across 154 floors, making it the tallest all-residential building in the world — taller than New York’s Central Park Tower, and the tallest tower of its kind planned in Brazil.
It is rising in Barra Sul, Balneário Camboriú, on Brazil’s Santa Catarina coast.

Is Senna Tower being built, and when is it ready?
Yes — the project broke ground in the second half of 2025 and is currently in its off-plan phase, with delivery estimated between 2033 and 2035.

It will be developed on the front-row, a location reserved for luxury towers.
The Launiu will be the 11th tower in Ward Village and broke ground on October 21, 2025.
The Launiu is being designed with an undulating exterior, referencing a mid-20th century Honolulu / international coastal style.
The tower intends to keep to the tenets of the neighborhood - maximizing mauka-makai view corridors while creating a livable space that enhances the pedestrian experience.
The Launiu's name means 'Coconut Leaf,' named for the coconut groves that covered the area during Victoria Ward's ownership of the land.
It will be located in the Ward Village neighborhood, a master-planned community developed by the Howard Hughes Corporation.
The planned development site is at the intersection of Ward Avenue and Ala Moana Boulevard.

It is heavy on amenities and similar to Kalae, another front-row tower, in many ways.
Permits indicate the Launiu's development will contain 21,726 sqft.
of commercial and retail space in addition to 78,310 sqft.
of recreational space, much of which represents the building's unique selling point of being very amenity-focused.
It will be a 40-story tower, containing a total of 486 units in studio to 3-Bed floor plans.
The units will be distributed between the tower and podium, with the tower containing 396 units, with some featuring lanais on both the Diamond Head and Ewa side of the tower.
The podium will contain the remaining 90 units, mostly in Studio floor plans.
The building will overlook Kewalo Basin and sport an undulating design that references a mid-20th century Honolulu international coastal style.
The Launiu is being developed by the Howard Hughes Corporation in conjunction with Arquitectonica as architects, ODADA as interior designers, and VITA Planning & Landscape Architecture.
Location The Launiu Ward Village is a new residential condo tower in Honolulu that has begun sales.
It will be situated on the front-row in the Ward Village neighborhood, a master-planned community within the larger Kaka’ako area.
To the east of Ward Village is Ala Moana, Waikiki, and Diamond Head, giving residents of the neighborhood easy access to the Honolulu nightlife.
The Launiu is being developed at the corner of Ala Moana Boulevard and Ward Avenue, across the street from the Kalae development, another new tower coming to Ward Village that just broke ground.
The Launiu will be on the opposite side of Ward Ave.
from Kalae's development.
The entrance will lie on Auahi Street, near the lower left in the above image.
Since The Launiu is on the edge of the front row, it provides a closer connection to Our Kaka'ako than many other towers in the neighborhood.
Ward Village is a master-planned community in the Kaka’ako area of Honolulu, built from the ground up to be pedestrian friendly.
It offers plenty of shopping, dining, and retail spaces in addition the Ward Entertainment Center, a multipurpose venue.

Take a leisurely stroll in the neighborhood and you're bound to find charming cafes to visit, amazing restaurants and bars for a night out, and even high-tech co-working spaces with breathtaking views of the ocean.
You can read more about the Ward Village Master Plan here .
Resident Lifestyle The Launiu's lifestyle will be a mix of modern luxury blended with a unique Hawaii charm.
Think calm mornings on your east-facing lanai, exceptional service from on-site staff, and amenities that'll put a lot of other towers to shame.
The Launiu is heavy on the amenities and it also ensures better privacy for you when using those amenities.
This tower's amenity deck is a floor above that of Kalae and Alia, the neighboring buildings, offering a higher vantage point for ocean views.
The streetscapes are very pedestrian-friendly, allowing for seamless integration of towers with the surrounding area.
With Ward Village being a very walkable neighborhood, you're always going to be a short walk away from the modern conveniences, with the beach a slightly more leisurely stroll away.

The unique location of The Launiu means that residents also have easy access to everything that the Our Kakaako neighborhood has to offer - meaning residents have an abundnace of trendy boutiques, amazing restaurants, bars, community spaces, and events not far from their front door.
To the east is the Ala Moana Shopping Center , the largest open-air shopping center in the world.
Not to be outshone, to the west lies SALT at Our Kakaako .
Services & Amenities The Launiu will have a 7th floor amenity terrace atop the podium, complete with lush green spaces and sweeping views.
The breezeway will create a framed view of Diamond Head as the fitness areas seamlessly blend indoor and outdoor spaces.
Meanwhile, the ground floor of The Launiu will have both outdoor and indoor recreational space, including gardens, a dog run, and casual meeting spaces in addition to commercial retail locations.

The podium will hold 90 units, mostly in Studio floor plans, while the tower will the remaining 396 units in floor plans that range from Studio to 3-Bed.
The Studios are particularly seeing a lot of interest from buyers as the developer Howard Hughes hasn't previously put them in the other front-row towers.

Units in The Launiu will feature 9' ceilings and Oak wood engineered flooring in main living areas, with floor-to-ceiling windows and juliet balconies in living rooms.
Kitchens will include Studio Becker cabinets and Sub-Zero Appliances, plus Quartzite stone islands, countertops, and backsplashes.
The bathrooms have a minimalist design, with quartz countertops, porcelain tiles, and accent lighting.
Tower units on the Diamond Head side of the development will feature Lanai to accentuate the views while units on the sunset side will have Juliet balconies.
Upper level homes will include high-quality materials such as lava stone, opus incertum, cerused white oak, and adze finished millwork.
Some units on the Diamond Head side will feature deep furnishable balconies.
There won't be any reserved or affordable housing units in this project.

DarGlobal PLC is an international luxury real-estate developer listed on the London Stock Exchange , building rare, design-led schemes in the world's most sought-after cities.
The company is the international arm of Saudi Arabia's Dar Al Arkan Group and trades on the LSE Main Market under the ticker DAR .
It works hand-in-hand with globally recognised names — among them the Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott, Missoni, Pagani and Versace .
In Oman, DarGlobal is the master-developer of AIDA , a 4.3-million-sqm city set on the cliffs above Muscat Bay.
2017 Founded Dubai, United Arab Emirates Headquarters View DarGlobal About AIDA, Muscat DarGlobal's clifftop city above Muscat — Trump-branded golf living over the Gulf of Oman.
AIDA is a single Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) carved into the cliffs above Muscat , roughly 130 metres above the Gulf of Oman and spanning some 4.3 million sqm .

Master-developed by DarGlobal with the backing of OMRAN (Oman Tourism Development Company) , the community is anchored by Trump International Oman — a luxury hotel and an 18-hole championship golf course — alongside Marriott Residences and a family of branded villas and apartments.
As an ITC, AIDA grants 100% freehold ownership to buyers of any nationality , with Oman's 0% property and personal income tax and an investor residency pathway.
Owners already span more than 60 nationalities.

26 Jun 2026 26 Jun 2026 Whatsapp Print PDF Source: Supplied.

According to Benzing Properties asset manager and Cape Town Central City Improvement District (CCID) board member Joy Millar, improvements to safety, cleanliness, public spaces and property management are creating the conditions for renewed investment, attracting businesses, residents and developers, and repositioning the area as a thriving mixed-use destination.
“Upper Long Street has always had strong fundamentals – a central location, rich heritage architecture, excellent connectivity and a distinct identity that can't be replicated elsewhere in Cape Town.

"What we're seeing now is a demand for new businesses, hospitality offerings and residential development, signalling growing confidence that the area can realise its full potential,” says Millar, who is among a group of landlords actively investing in the precinct.
Renewed confidence and collaboration This momentum is being driven by collaboration between the City of Cape Town, the CCID, property owners, businesses and community organisations.

Together they are investing in the public realm through enhanced security, improved urban management, place making, lighting upgrades, building maintenance and the activation of previously underutilised spaces.
Developers, too, are signalling renewed confidence in the area.
Two years ago, Blok – an urban-precinct property developer – moved into the area, securing its first CBD location in Vredenburg Lane (just off Long Street).
The subsequent development, TenOnV, has delivered 152 apartments on the edge of the Company’s Garden.
Residents have just started moving in.
Blok has followed this up with another residential development in the precinct, namely the R650m residential development ElevenOnB, the company’s biggest and boldest development to date.
Construction begins soon, and the ambitious development is set to contribute quality retail venues which will be of great benefit to the day and night-time economies of the area.
Source: Supplied.
“The West City chose us as much as we chose it,” says Jacques van Embden, Blok founder and chief executive officer.
“Beyond the numbers that are needed to make a development viable, what draws us to a neighbourhood is the quality that already exists there.
"This isn't an area that needs to be invented, it already has 35 restaurants, 47 shops, good public transport, a world-class park, schools, gorgeous laneways and many cultural institutions.
It scores well against every dimension of what makes a thriving urban neighbourhood.

It just needs more people living in it.” Property lifestyle magazine launches with 50,000 print order 23 Jun 2026 He says that the addition of residential density is widely seen as a catalyst for change.
More permanent residents translate into increased footfall, stronger demand for daytime retail and improved passive surveillance, all of which contribute to a stronger sense of safety and stability.
For investors, safety remains one of the most important indicators of a precinct's long-term prospects.
In Long Street, investment in urban management and public safety sees the CCID playing a central role in creating a secure and welcoming environment for residents, businesses and visitors.

Community is key Tasso Evangelinos, chief executive officer of the CCID, says the organisation deploys hundreds of public safety officers (PSOs) across the CBD – including Long Street – working in partnership with the City of Cape Town and SAPS to address opportunistic crime and support the ongoing revitalisation of the area.
“We recognise that different kinds of support are needed at differing times of the day and areas of the city.
"Our safety officers are deployed 24/7 and at nighttime the number of PSOs may increase in different nodes, to have an increased security presence in these areas,” he says.
Community forums such as the Long Street Association (LSA), which was initially established in 2015, are also playing a role to renew confidence in Long Street.
Its aim is for businesses, property owners and partners to focus on safety, cleanliness, communication and street improvements as well as enhanced co-ordination.
“Our progress is grounded in collaboration.

Property owners, the City and local businesses are aligned around a shared vision to strengthen the precinct and create a better experience for everyone who lives, works and visits here,” says Romano Simpson, the chair of the LSA and owner of the Long Street Boutique Hotel.
On the ground, a new generation of independent businesses is reshaping the street’s character.
Among them are husband and wife duo Thomas and Natalia, of Hey, Stranger!
Coffee Collective, who chose upper Long as the home for their café.
“We were drawn to the street's character,” says Natalia.
“The foot traffic creates a strong sense of community and a character that's distinctly Cape Town.

We’re proud to strive to make our café a safe, welcoming and professional place that supports local economic development and allows locals and visitors to connect and experience the vibrancy of the area.” Millar believes the future is bright for Long Street, saying its distinctive character sets it apart from other Cape Town neighbourhoods and it continues to attract people to the city centre.

“As the sun rises on a new era of Long Street whether you’re heading home after a night out, arriving for an early meeting or grabbing a coffee at the end of your urban run, Long Street will welcome you, proudly,” Millar concludes.

The name comes from what these houses do best: catch the light.
Morning light on ochre stone, evening light crossing the single-storey living rooms, firelight from the brazier when the day withdraws.
Sixteen villas, sixteen different lights.
The name says the essential without promising more than what you see.

Hỏi giỏ hàng 4 phòng ngủ 09 — Điểm nổi bật Vì sao Gladia Heights đáng cân nhắc 4 điều tôi thấy đáng để anh chị cân nhắc — toàn bộ là sự thật kiểm chứng được, không có dự đoán giá.

Giấy tờ đủ trước ngày mở bán Giấy chứng nhận quyền sử dụng đất cấp ngày 7/11/2024, giấy phép xây dựng ngày 2/2/2026, văn bản đủ điều kiện bán số 26381/SXD-PTĐT của Sở Xây dựng ngày 23/7/2026 và bảo lãnh VietinBank — tất cả có trước ngày mở bán 1/8/2026.
Dự án cũng nằm trong danh mục người nước ngoài được sở hữu theo văn bản 2864/UBND-ĐT ngày 9/4/2026.
Liên doanh đã có sản phẩm bàn giao ngay bên cạnh Khu thấp tầng Gladia by the Waters 226 căn của cùng liên doanh đã xây xong và trao sổ hồng cho cư dân ngày 25/1/2026, khoảng 3 tháng sau khi mở bán.
Anh chị đi xem khu thấp tầng là thấy chất lượng hoàn thiện thật, không phải xem phối cảnh.
Đất 3 mặt hướng sông, 70 % căn nhìn sông Khu đất 1,26 ha có 3 mặt hướng sông; theo chủ đầu tư khoảng 70 % căn hướng sông, 30 % nhìn hồ bơi nội khu.
Số căn một tầng từ 8 (B1) đến 20 (B3) — anh chị so với dự án khác bằng mặt bằng tầng, tôi gửi cả 2 bản.
Pháp nhân ký hợp đồng tra được trong 10 phút Khang Điền niêm yết mã KDH và công bố báo cáo tài chính theo quý, Keppel niêm yết ở Singapore; hai bên đều đứng tên trên thông cáo của dự án.
Bên ký hợp đồng với anh chị là Công ty TNHH Đầu tư Kinh doanh nhà Đoàn Nguyên — anh chị đọc đúng tên này ở trang đầu hợp đồng rồi tra trên Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp.
10 — Sống ở đây Ở Gladia Heights thì thế nào?
Nếu mua để ở, 3 điều khách hỏi tôi nhiều nhất về khu này: Sông và công viên ở ngay dưới 3 mặt khu đất hướng sông, phía đông là khu biệt thự ven sông đã có người ở, phía nam là công viên nội khu.
Cụm đô thị có 5 công viên chủ đề và 2 km đường đi bộ ven sông dùng chung.
Tiện ích trong khu và quanh khu 2 cụm hồ bơi, 2 clubhouse có gym, yoga, phòng chơi trẻ em, sân tennis và 23 căn thương mại tầng trệt.
Trường học, y tế và trung tâm thương mại của cụm đô thị 60 ha còn theo quy hoạch — anh chị hỏi tôi hạng mục nào đã có, hạng mục nào chưa.
Đi lại Ra Võ Chí Công là lên Vành đai 2, qua nút giao Mỹ Thuỷ về Thủ Thiêm và Quận 1 cũ khoảng 15–20 phút giờ thường; ra cao tốc Long Thành dưới 2 km.
Giờ cao điểm trục này đông và có xe container ra cảng Cát Lái, anh chị chạy thử một buổi sáng trước khi quyết.

12 — Chủ đầu tư Liên doanh Keppel × Khang Điền là ai?
Keppel (Singapore) mua 49 % của 2 dự án liền kề tổng 11,8 ha của Khang Điền tại Thủ Đức năm 2023 với giá 3.180 tỷ , rồi hai bên cùng phát triển thành Gladia by the Waters.

Khang Điền (mã KDH, 25 năm) đã bàn giao Jamila, Safira, Lovera Vista, The Classia, Verosa Park và The Privia; Keppel có hơn 30 năm ở Việt Nam với Saigon Centre, The Estella, Estella Heights, Riviera Point, Palm City.

Theo bảng giá tham khảo tháng 9/2026, Gladia Heights chào từ 83 triệu/m² tim tường với căn bàn giao tiêu chuẩn và từ 91 triệu/m² với căn bàn giao hoàn thiện, chưa VAT.

What do apartments cost?
Phase 1 is on sale now: one-beds start from £198,000, two-beds from £298,000 and the one three-bed available is £365,000.

When does Imperial Exchange complete?
Completion is expected in the fourth quarter of 2028.
What lease comes with each apartment?
Every apartment is held on a 999-year lease, so you own the home for the long term rather than a short, depreciating lease you would later need to extend.
Can I let the apartment on a short-term basis?
Yes.
Short-term lets are approved building-wide, which is unusual for a central-Liverpool building, so you can let on either a long-term residential tenancy or a short-let basis.
What return can I expect?
We share an indicative gross yield, and the rental evidence behind it, in the data pack.
Any figure is indicative only, calculated before costs, and is not a guaranteed return; property values and rental income can fall as well as rise.
Is there parking?
The building has 51 secure car parking spaces, with allocation confirmed in the data pack.
Who will I be dealing with?
Falcon, directly.
We are closely involved in shaping the building and we run the sales ourselves, so from your first enquiry through to completion you deal with the principals rather than a detached listing agent.
How do I reserve an apartment?
Ask about any apartment on this page, or request the data pack, with floorplans and the reservation terms.
When you are ready, the apartment is reserved under an agreement with the development’s vendor, who is named in that agreement.
Is the planning approved?
Liverpool City Council approved the conversion to 95 apartments in August 2026, under references 26F/1624 and 26/PCU/1639.

Do I pay Falcon a fee?
No.

Revise Plans for ‘Sereno’ at 2901 N.E.

Ninth Court, Fort Lauderdale, Florida Image by FSMY Architects + Planners By: Colt Dodd 7:00 am on December 23, 2025 Florida YIMBY has an update regarding Sereno , a venture we covered earlier this March.
Initial plans called for a 14-story tower with 76 condos, measuring 1,080 to 2,400 square feet each.
They were slated to cost $1.4 million each.
Now, plans have changed significantly.
Revised plans call for more condos, hotels, and commercial space.
Sereno would still measure 14 stories above grade, but new plans would feature 88 homes – downsized to measure 372 to 1,252 square feet.
Floorplans would span studio to three-bedroom units.
There would also be 113 hotel keys, 1,800 square feet of commercial space, and 200 parking spots in a four-story parking structure.
There would be two swimming pools: one for hotel guests on the parking garage’s rooftop and another on the tower’s rooftop for residents.
There would also be separate entrances.
Integra Investments and Surfside-based Flying Point, through their affiliate Sunrise FTL Ventures LLLP, have partnered on the venture.
Fort Lauderdale-based FSMY Architects + Planners is the architect.
In total, Sereno would span 197,671 square feet of new construction and occupy a 2.2-acre site.
Sereno would occupy 2901 N.E.
Ninth Court, Fort Lauderdale, Florida , 3304, in Broward County.
It would lie directly south of Hugh Taylor Birch State Park and north of Las Olas.

The Legend Danang chọn khu đất A20 ngay đầu cầu với triết lý kề bên biểu tượng, để trở thành một biểu tượng mới .

Thân rồng mô phỏng rồng thời Lý, đầu rồng hướng ra biển Đông, thể hiện khát vọng vươn ra biển lớn.

Nếu Cầu Rồng là con rồng vươn ra biển Đông, The Legend Danang là con rồng thứ hai sánh đôi bên bờ sông Hàn.

Hồ bơi vô cực và hồ bơi 4 mùa với tầm nhìn thoáng mở Phòng gym tiêu chuẩn quốc tế, khu yoga, golf 3D Business lounge, party house, cinema Lounge, cabana, khu thư giãn có mái che Khu tổ chức tiệc ngoài trời và không gian trò chuyện Khu vui chơi trẻ em Kid Zone và Kid Lounge Cảnh quan tầng 3 8.3.

Tiện ích tầng mái Tầng mái được phát triển như một “sky resort” với tầm nhìn panorama ra sông Hàn và biển Mỹ Khê, gồm: Sky lounge, vườn treo, hồ phản chiếu cảnh quan Đài quan sát với chòi nghỉ Sàn vọng cảnh với kính viễn vọng (panoramic point) Không gian ngắm cảnh và tổ chức hoạt động cộng đồng Lối đi dạo kết hợp ánh sáng, khu ngồi thư giãn Vườn BBQ Mặt bằng tầng mái Tham khảo chi tiết: Hệ tiện ích The Legend Danang – Bespoke Living, nâng tầm trải nghiệm sống 9.

Tiến độ dự án The Legend City Đà Nẵng và thời gian bàn giao 28/02/2025: Khởi công dự án 04–05/08/2026: Đổ bê tông sàn dầm chuyển tầng 4 06/09/2026: Hoàn thành hệ dầm chuyển 31/03/2028: Dự kiến bàn giao Công trường The Legend Danang đang thi công đúng kế hoạch.
Đêm 04/08/2026, dự án đổ bê tông sàn dầm chuyển tầng 4, cao 2,7 m và rộng 2,95 m, được ghi nhận là lớn nhất Đà Nẵng hiện nay.
Ngày 06/09/2026, toàn bộ hệ dầm chuyển hoàn thành, sau 1 tháng thi công.
Dự án áp dụng công nghệ cốp pha nhôm (Aluminium Formwork), giúp tăng độ chính xác và chất lượng bề mặt bê tông.
Chu kỳ thi công được rút ngắn còn khoảng 7 ngày/tầng, tạo nền tảng để dự án tăng tốc ở các giai đoạn tiếp theo.
> Xem chi tiết: Cập nhật tiến độ mới nhất dự án The Legend Danang 10.
Vì sao nên chọn The Legend Đà Nẵng?
Vị trí 4 mặt tiền ngay đầu Cầu Rồng: The Legend Cầu Rồng có tầm nhìn trực diện Cầu Rồng, sông Hàn và pháo hoa, nằm trên trục Võ Văn Kiệt nối sân bay với biển Mỹ Khê.
Pháp lý công khai: 9 hồ sơ pháp lý được công bố đầy đủ, 800 căn hộ đủ điều kiện bán theo văn bản 1818/SXD-QLN, có cam kết phát hành thư bảo lãnh của MSB.
Sở hữu lâu dài: 800 căn hộ thương mại tại tòa căn hộ được sở hữu lâu dài.
Đội ngũ đối tác quốc tế: HBA thiết kế kiến trúc và nội thất, NDA Group thiết kế cảnh quan, Boydens Engineering tư vấn cơ điện, CBRE tư vấn vận hành, Central thi công.
Hơn 45 tiện ích nội khu: hồ bơi vô cực, hồ bơi 4 mùa, gym, golf 3D, cinema, sky lounge,… trải nghiệm nghỉ dưỡng ngay trong khuôn viên.
Tiến độ rõ ràng: khởi công 28/02/2025, thi công bằng cốp pha nhôm khoảng 7 ngày/tầng, dự kiến bàn giao 31/03/2028.
Đa dạng nhu cầu: căn 1PN và 1PN+1 phù hợp cặp đôi, gia đình trẻ và nhu cầu cho thuê; căn 2PN, 3PN phù hợp gia đình 3–5 người; Penthouse dành cho khách hàng cần không gian riêng biệt.
Câu hỏi thường gặp về The Legend Danang Chủ đầu tư The Legend Danang là ai?
Chủ đầu tư là Công ty TNHH MTV Vipico.
ROX Signature là đơn vị tư vấn phát triển, Central là tổng thầu xây dựng.
ROX Signature là công ty gì?

ROX Signature là thương hiệu bất động sản cao cấp và hạng sang thuộc hệ sinh thái của ROX Group (tiền thân là TNG Holdings Vietnam) – tập đoàn đầu tư đa ngành lớn tại Việt Nam với lịch sử phát triển 30 năm.
Tại The Legend Danang, ROX Signature là đơn vị tư vấn phát triển, chính thức ra mắt ngày 26/07/2025 tại Đà Nẵng.
Pháp lý The Legend Danang đã đủ điều kiện bán chưa?
Đã đủ.
Theo văn bản số 1818/SXD-QLN ngày 30/01/2026 của Sở Xây dựng Đà Nẵng, 800 căn hộ đủ điều kiện bán nhà ở hình thành trong tương lai.
Xem toàn bộ hồ sơ tại hệ thống pháp lý The Legend Danang .
Căn hộ The Legend Danang được sở hữu bao lâu?
800 căn hộ thương mại tại tòa căn hộ được sở hữu lâu dài.
Căn hộ dịch vụ Hyde Living và phòng khách sạn Hyde Hotel tại tòa khách sạn có thời hạn sở hữu 50 năm.
Giá căn hộ The Legend Đà Nẵng bao nhiêu?
Giá tham khảo sau chiết khấu và ưu đãi từ 4.701.126.004 VND (căn 1PN, 38,1 m²) đến 13.132.047.766 VND (căn 3PN, 108,5 m²).
Giá thực tế thay đổi theo mã căn, tầng và hướng view.
Xem bảng giá căn hộ The Legend Đà Nẵng theo từng mã căn.
Chính sách bán hàng The Legend Đà Nẵng hiện nay có gì?

Khách hàng được tặng gói nội thất 300.000.000 VND (1PN, 1PN+1), 500.000.000 VND (2PN), 700.000.000 VND (3PN) hoặc 1.800.000.000 VND (Penthouse); căn 1PN, 1PN+1 và trục L.10, L.11 được tặng thêm 150.000.000 VND quà an cư.
Thanh toán sớm 50%, 70% hoặc 95% được chiết khấu lần lượt 6%, 8% và 12%.
Mua trả góp như thế nào?
Giữ chỗ 200.000.000 VND, trả trước tối thiểu 25%, vay tối đa 70%, lãi 0% trong 24 tháng, thời gian ân hạn nợ gốc của từng ngân hàng.
Cụ thể: ân hạn nợ gốc 36 tháng với MSB, 24 tháng với Vietcombank và MB; khách hàng cần có thông báo chấp thuận cho vay của ngân hàng.
Khi nào dự án The Legend City Đà Nẵng bàn giao?
Dự án khởi công ngày 28/02/2025 và dự kiến bàn giao ngày 31/03/2028.
The Legend Đà Nẵng có những tiện ích gì?

Dự án có hơn 45 tiện ích trên 3 tầng: sảnh đón chuẩn 5 sao và khu thương mại ở tầng trệt; hồ bơi vô cực, hồ bơi 4 mùa, gym, yoga, golf 3D, business lounge, party house, cinema, khu vui chơi trẻ em ở tầng 3; sky lounge, vườn treo, đài quan sát, vườn BBQ ở tầng mái.
Người nước ngoài có được mua căn hộ The Legend Đà Nẵng không?
Theo Luật Nhà ở 2023, cá nhân nước ngoài được phép nhập cảnh vào Việt Nam có thể sở hữu căn hộ chung cư thương mại, tối đa 30% số căn của một tòa nhà, thời hạn sở hữu tối đa 50 năm và có thể gia hạn.
Quý khách vui lòng liên hệ để được kiểm tra quỹ căn dành cho người nước ngoài.
Muốn mua căn hộ The Legend Danang thì liên hệ ai?
Quý khách liên hệ hotline chính thức 1800 2822 68 hoặc đăng ký trên website thelegenddanang.vn.
Nhà mẫu đặt tại tầng 4 và 5, lô A33-A34 đường 2 Tháng 9, phường Hải Châu, đối diện công viên APEC; nên đặt lịch trước khi đến.
Để tránh giao dịch qua đơn vị không được ủy quyền, quý khách xem danh sách đại lý phân phối chính thức của dự án.
Quý khách quan tâm đến dự án The Legend City Đà Nẵng có thể liên hệ đội ngũ tư vấn để nhận thông tin chi tiết, tham quan nhà mẫu và cập nhật chính sách mới nhất.

a once-in-a-lifetime residential ownership opportunity The Point RESIDENCES Lifestyle Grace Bay Resorts is delighted to introduce the latest chapter in the evolution of the iconic Point Grace resort, one of the boutique pioneers in Turks & Caicos upon its completion in 1999.

As a member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World, Point Grace has been renowned for its prestigious stretch of beach on Grace Bay, unparalleled level of tranquility, and one of the island’s iconic restaurants, Grace’s Cottage.

All of these features are within walking distance of some of Providenciales’ finest shops, dining options, and attractions Spanning over 9.5 acres, The Point is an exceptional low-density oceanfront development of the highest caliber.
The development comprises 38 stunning oceanfront condominiums, ranging from two to five bedrooms, along with a diverse range of new resort amenities.

These include a new adults-only swimming pool and three additional pools for families, new oceanfront dining and bars, a new world-class spa and fitness center, tennis and pickle ball courts, a discovery center for kids, and a new arrival pavilion.
All of these amenities have been redesigned with a new entrance off the main thoroughfare of Grace Bay.
Furthermore, the project is unveiling 16 innovative and sophisticated “casitas” in an elegant residential grove.
Each casita boasts two bedrooms, a private pool, and garden.
These casitas also enjoy all of the benefits and amenities of The Point, just steps away from its dining and beach.
They offer a level of privacy that has not been seen in a resort on Grace Bay before.

Each of these will have typical strata or homeowner fees covering costs such as common area maintenance, insurance, security, and administration.
These fees will be reasonable and market-related, and owners will receive an estimate closer to construction completion based on costs at that time.
All owners will have the right to use resort amenities, services, and infrastructure.
GOVERNMENT CONCESSIONS – RENTAL PROGRAM & TAXES To encourage tourism development, the Turks and Caicos Islands Government will likely provide the project with a Development Agreement.

This agreement provides significant financial concessions on import duties during the construction stage of the project, with a requirement that the project will generate reliable accommodation taxes through an active rental program.
The project will make heavy investments in a new amenity set that owners will enjoy.
This includes an active food & beverage component and other resort services that a typical condo would not provide.
The success of these investments is directly associated with an active rental program.
Over its 2 decades in the Turks and Caicos Islands, Grace Bay Resorts has been a market leader in delivering top-of-the-market vacations to its owners and luxury travelers.
This provides revenues to offset ownership costs.
Purchasers seeking a retirement or pure residential experience are discouraged.

Set within the Al Bedea suburb of Hayyan, this development brings together a refined selection of 2 to 6-bedroom townhouses and villas, each designed to offer something increasingly rare in modern urban living — genuine harmony between comfort, nature, and community.
Deem is not simply a collection of homes.
It is a carefully curated neighborhood where every design decision, every planted garden, and every shared space has been considered with the resident's daily experience in mind.
For families seeking a long-term home, and investors looking for enduring value in one of the UAE's most stable markets, Deem represents a compelling opportunity at exactly the right moment.
Prime Location: Sharjah, Hayyan Hayyan is among Sharjah's most desirable suburban destinations, and for good reason.

The area strikes a balance that many urban communities struggle to achieve — it feels spacious and green without being remote, and it offers the calm of a low-density neighborhood while remaining connected to the broader city fabric.
The Al Bedea suburb, where Deem sits, is particularly valued for its clean planning, wide roads, and a residential atmosphere that feels intentional rather than incidental.

Living in Hayyan means waking up to open skies and landscaped surroundings rather than congested streets, while still having access to Sharjah's growing infrastructure of schools, healthcare, retail, and cultural destinations.
For families especially, this setting offers the kind of environment where children can grow up with room to breathe.

With its year-round sunshine, peaceful beaches, unspoiled natural landscapes, and ancient mangroves, Ajman provides a serene escape from the fast pace of modern life.
Its blend of rich traditions, authentic culture, and modern infrastructure creates a truly distinctive living experience.
Ajman's growing appeal and commitment to sustainable development continue to attract investors eager to explore its promising business landscape.
The establishment of the Ajman Free Zone and recent investor visa reforms have boosted confidence among foreign investors, injecting more liquidity into the local economy.
New UAE regulations offering pathways to citizenship and a more welcoming environment for expatriates further position Ajman as a thriving destination for living and business.
Thanks to its steady development and cultural heritage, Ajman offers a calming yet luxurious atmosphere.
This unique combination gives it an edge over other emirates, making it especially attractive for those seeking comfort, elegance, and peace in one place.

Saint Vlas Святой Влас находится в живописном районе Болгарского побережья – у последних подступах горы Стара планина, которые плавно спускаются в хрустально чистые воды необъятного Черного моря.
Это благоприятное сочетание предлагает много солнечных дней (среднее 260 в год), прохладные вечери чистый воздух и идеальные условия для лечения заболеваний легких.
Кроме идеального климата, который приближается к средиземноморскому, Святой Влас владеет интересной историей.
1800 лет тому назад, на месте шикарной яхтенной пристани и фешенебельных комплексов, был расположен фракийский поселок.
В этот период город был известен под именем Лариса, а настоящее имя святого покровителя торговли, приобрел в 14 веке.
Пляжная полоса курортного города имеет длину 1,5 км и широту на местах до 16 метров.
Владеет тремя красивыми пляжами с мелким золотистым песком, которые по мнению Европейской комиссии, являются одними из самых чистых и привлекательных для летнего отдыха в Болгарии.
Если захочется развлечений, Солнечный берег находится всего в несколько минут езды на машите, а если Вы любители достопримечательностей, то уникальный в своем историческом и культурном наследии г.
Несебр расположен в 10 км.
В 2007 г., в Святом Власе был построен самый большой яхтенной порт в Болгарии – Марина Диневи, рассчитан на 300 яхт.
В акватории залива каждый год с 18 по 20 июля проводится регата под названием " Святой Влас ", которая организуется морским клубом "Несебър 2000".
В августе проводится ралли суперкаров.
Ярмарку города можете посетить каждый год 2 мая.
Святой Влас город с европейским обликом, который имеет свое очарование во время всех сезонах года.
Осени исключительно мягкие и теплые, весна вдохновляет красотой расцветающей растительностью, а зимой снежные склоны горы Стара планина заставят Вас погрузиться в зимнюю сказку.

Район предлагает большое разнообразие недвижимости разного типа – студии , квартиры ( двухкомнатные , трехкомнатные , многокомнатные ), мезонины , пентхаусы , таун-хаусы , дома с участком , которая продается напрямую от застройщика , или как выгодная вторичная продажа .
В Святом Власе можете приобрести выгодно свое жилье на первой линии , для круглогодичного проживания , с видом на море или воспользоваться возможностью покупки в рассрочку .

Recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1980, history dating from the Neolithic, Greek, Roman, and Medieval ages is right beneath your feet.
Its rich archaeological treasures include the Tombs of the Kings and the vast Paphos Archaeological Park.

The city's vibrant modern infrastructure, underscored by its 2017 designation as the European Capital of Culture, boasts a dynamic arts scene, numerous festivals, and a commitment to preserving its heritage.
Paphos offers unlimited leisure and recreational opportunities; residents enjoy over 300 days of sunshine each year, picturesque beaches, and crystal-clear waters.
Today, Paphos presents a diverse array of attractions and amenities appealing to both residents and investors.
The city’s serene natural landscapes and scenic coastal paths offer opportunities for relaxation and an active lifestyle.

Serving as a social hub, the Paphos harbour is perfect for dining and entertaining residents with a plethora of cafes, restaurants, and traditional markets, all while absorbing the sun rays and enjoying the stunning waterfront views.
For shopping enthusiasts, Kings Avenue Mall provides a wide range of retail options and conveniences.

Whether you’re drawn to exploring ancient ruins, sampling delicious local cuisine, enjoying vibrant cultural events, or simply taking advantage of the proximity to beautiful beaches and modern amenities, Paphos promises a captivating experience and a potentially sound real estate investment that seamlessly connects the past with the present.

Set within private grounds, residents benefit from access to an outdoor swimming pool, a spa, a fully equipped gym, and dedicated concierge.
The property includes four garden apartments plus four duplex apartments ranging from two to three bedrooms.
Set for completion in the final quarter of 2028, La Réserve du Cap is an exceptional residential development in Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat.
A residence that preserves privacy The property is thoughtfully designed with privacy in mind and offers a collection of exclusive amenities.
Each apartment includes balconies, privacy screens, and parking.

Residents benefit from several outdoor areas and green spaces, including a heated swimming pool set within natural surroundings, a landscaped inner courtyard, and private gardens for some ground-floor apartments.
A full gym and a private wellness spa featuring a sauna, showers, and relaxation loungers are available.
Deluxe amenities These apartments have been crafted to ensure the highest standard of luxury living.
Each is equipped with reversible air conditioning, solid wood herringbone parquet floors, natural stone finishes, and ceramic furnishing within bathrooms.
There are two elevators which service the buildings.

Ideally set between Nice and Monaco, an address at La Réserve du Cap grants access to several Riviera hotspots, including Villefranche-sur-Mer, Beaulieu-sur-Mer, Èze, Cap-d’Ail, and Roquebrune-Cap-Martin.
A historic peninsula with stories to tell In the late 19th century, Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat was a discrete refuge for royalty and influential families.
King Leopold II of Belgium made it his residence, and families such as the Rothschilds built grand villas to reflect the elegance and ambition of this golden age.
As the 20th century unfolded, the area drew creatives such as Jean Cocteau, David Niven, and Grace Kelly.
From European royalty to Belle Epoque artists, Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat became known not only for its exclusivity, but also as a centre for innovation, artistry, and refinement on the French Riviera.
For further information on La Réserve du Cap, please contact the dedicated Savills Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat team.
