Borgo Residential and Commercial Development Website Borgo is the newest premium residential development in Vilnius, located on one of the most distinctive sites in the historic Old Town, next to the renowned MO Museum.

Set on a hillside within the UNESCO World Heritage area, the project embraces the unique character of its surroundings, combining historical heritage with contemporary architecture to create an exceptional place to live.

Inspired by the rich urban history of Vilnius, Borgo has been designed around the careful restoration of a historic building and the addition of a contemporary architectural volume that respectfully complements its surroundings.
Rather than replacing the past, the project preserves and reinterprets it, giving new purpose to a landmark that has long been part of the city’s story.

The project will consist of a limited collection of approximately 53 premium residences (total gross buildable area: 5,741 m²), complemented by carefully integrated commercial spaces and underground parking.

Positioned above the city, many homes will enjoy views across the rooftops and church towers of Vilnius Old Town, while residents will find themselves within walking distance of the city’s finest cultural destinations, restaurants, cafés and green public spaces.
Borgo continues Pro Kapital’s long-standing vision of shaping living environments that stand the test of time.

Following the success of the nearby Šaltinių Namai | Attico neighbourhood, the project represents another carefully considered investment in the future of Vilnius Old Town—creating homes that offer not only exceptional quality and design, but also a genuine connection to the city’s history, architecture and everyday life.

Šaltinių Namai | Attico Residential and Commercial District Website Šaltinių Namai | Attico is a prestigious living area, surrounded by the nature in the most tranquil part of the Old Town, located within the UNESCO protection area.
Šaltinių Namai | Attico is inspired by the baroque spirit of Vilnius Old Town and the tradition of Italian architecture in Lithuania.
Šaltinių Namai | Attico is planned for different user journeys – so that every home or business owner would feel welcomed and good here.
Homebuyers can choose from thoroughly planned apartments with exceptional views, spacious properties with roof top terraces, height ceiling and showcase windows to panoramic view.
As an integral part of the landscape, this unique area has the first Italian courtyard garden in the city, designed by an Italian concept architect Gianmarco Cavagnino.
To date we have completed five houses of the Šaltinių Namai | Attico project.
Šaltinių Namai | Attico is a residential and business area, with emphasis on the secure and comfortable living environment and car-free city-space.
The first phase was completed in 2019.
Šaltinių Namai | Attico is truly valued by people for the exceptionally high quality, functionality, thoughtful user experience, security and comfort.
Here, right on the border of the Old Town of Vilnius, people live like in the garden city – away from the noise of the city centre and yet right in the heart of Vilnius.

Ongoing Developments: Šaltinių Namai | City Villas & Business Residential and Commercial Šaltinių Namai City Villas & Business is the final completed phase of the prestigious Šaltinių Namai | Attico quarter in central Vilnius.
Located within the UNESCO World Heritage protection area, the development combines exclusive residential living with boutique commercial premises in a carefully designed urban environment.
Completed in the first quarter of 2026, the development comprises 59 residential and commercial units with a combined gross buildable area of 9,578 m².
The project includes luxury apartments, spacious homes with private rooftop terraces, and commercial premises integrated into the quarter’s distinctive architectural concept.

Designed for residents and businesses seeking quality, privacy, and a unique location, Šaltinių Namai City Villas & Business offers exceptional views towards Vilnius Old Town, generous layouts, and a tranquil garden-city atmosphere within walking distance of the city centre.

As one of the final phases of the Šaltinių Namai neighbourhood, the development reflects the evolution of premium urban living in Vilnius, combining high-quality architecture, carefully curated public spaces, and an outstanding residential environment.
Kliversala Bay Residential and Commercial District Website Located within the UNESCO World Heritage protection zone, Klīversala is one of Riga’s most prestigious waterfront areas.
Situated on the banks of the Daugava River opposite Old Town Riga, it combines historic charm with contemporary urban living.
Kliversala Bay is being developed as a modern mixed-use neighbourhood featuring residential buildings, cafés, restaurants, and public spaces in a vibrant yet thoughtfully designed environment.

Upon completion of all planned development phases, the quarter is expected to deliver approximately 670 apartments with a total gross buildable area of 105,000 m², establishing Klīversala as one of the most significant waterfront residential destinations in Riga.
Ongoing developments: Blue Marine Residence Blue Marine Residence is a premium waterfront residential development located in the rapidly transforming Āgenskalns Bay area of Riga.

Positioned directly on the banks of the Daugava River, the project combines contemporary architecture, energy-efficient solutions, and carefully designed living spaces with exceptional waterfront views.
Blue Marine Residence construction commenced in August 2025, with completion scheduled for August 2027.
The development will comprise 96 apartments with a gross buildable area of 12,569 m².
Many apartments will feature spacious balconies or terraces, maximizing natural light and views of the river and surrounding cityscape.
Located close to Riga’s city centre, Blue Marine Residence offers a unique balance between urban convenience and a peaceful waterfront lifestyle.
The project forms part of the ongoing regeneration of the Āgenskalns Bay area, one of Riga’s most promising residential destinations.

Upon completion, the project is planned to comprise approximately 41,300 m² of gross buildable area, delivering a diverse collection of modern homes together with integrated commercial spaces.

Brīvības street Business Quarter in Riga Business centre View project Brīvības Street Business Quarter is a planned mixed-use business development located along one of Riga’s main transport arteries – Brīvības Street.

Playground Residences - Jack's Bay, Eleuthera Bahamas Skip to content INQUIRE – AN OASIS FOR THE SOUL – Jack's Bay is a club and residential community nestled on the lush coast of Eleuthera Island.
Nearly four miles of breathtaking oceanfront property and a wide array of refined amenities.
A relaxed island that is the ideal setting to connect, dream and grow.
A club designed to provide you with everything you need to experience high-end living that is as relaxed as it is reinvigorating.
Welcome to Jack’s Bay.
INTRODUCING THE PLAYGROUND RESIDENCES Where two courses, and a world of experience, come together.
The Playground Residences are not about escape.
They are about arrival.

Here, on these bluffs, overlooking the Tiger Woods Playground Golf Course and the Atlantic stretching endlessly beyond, these turn-key, fully-furnished residences are crafted with an eye for the small things—the angle of the light in the morning, the inviting nooks to relax with a book as the day turns into evening, the sound of the ocean slipping through an open window at night.

The Residences Two-, three- and four-bedroom turn-key, fully-furnished residences are each delivered with a private pool and rooftop deck, a wet bar with wine storage, an owner’s closet and covered car port.
Modern comfort blends effortlessly with timeless aesthetics.
At Jack’s Bay, the Tiger Woods 10-Hole Playground Course that borders jagged cliffs and pink-sand beaches is meant for barefoot golfers of all levels.

Taking their inspiration from it, the Playground Residences, are Jack's Bay's only homes adjacent to both this course and the Jack Nicklaus Heritage™ course, and celebrate the easygoing, playful spirit of Eleuthera—where luxury and leisure blend seamlessly.

ELEUTHERA ISLAND Anchored in history, imbued with endless possibility When iconic Pan Am Airlines founder, Juan Trippe, discovered this hidden-away corner of Eleuthera, he made it his home away from home.
In the following years, the island was a favorite destination for notable and influential jet-setting families.
With natural, restorative powers and a playfully lush atmosphere, Jack’s Bay allows you to follow your passion wherever it leads.
– Four miles of extraordinary shoreline – At Jack's Bay, You Chart Your Course Experience a life of barefoot luxury.
Discover a place where bay meets sea.
Where soaring bluffs unfold to reveal pink sand beaches.
By thoughtfully combining the restorative powers of Jack’s Bay with our curation of the grounds, buildings and amenities, we have created a modern-day sanctuary for mind, body and soul.
You must seek us out to find us, but once you’re here, you’ll discover a breadth and depth to life that you’ve never imagined.
"We have the opportunity to build this course on one of the best pieces of property around the world." TIGER WOODS on his first trip to Jack’s Bay Your browser does not support the video tag.
Tiger Woods & Nicklaus Design.
A vision that comes together at Jack's Bay.
A first and only.
Jack’s Bay will have two world-class golf courses on property – an existing Tiger Woods Playground Course and the first ever Jack Nicklaus Heritage™ course.
It also marks the only time these two great design teams in golf come together on one private property anywhere in the Caribbean.
With breathtaking bluffside views, golf at Jack’s Bay inspires like the greatest seaside courses in the world.
– LAY BACK.
LEAN IN.
– From barefoot golf to authentic culinary experiences, natural caves to our own private islands, Jack's Bay unlocks the best secrets of The Bahamas.

From adventurous water activities to meditative moments on dreamy hiking trails and natural lakes, Jack’s Bay inspires and invigorates.
Make your home where nature captivates and experiences illuminate.
Over 1,200 privately-owned acres and nearly four miles of beachfront, Jack’s Bay provides a backdrop like none other for your home in the Bahamas.
An enviable slate of Club amenities and unforgettable experiences will leave an imprint on your family for generations.

This small community, previously a quiet fishing village, has become a popular tourist destination although it has retained its authenticity, charm, and peaceful ambience.
San Telmo sits on the shores of the Mediterranean with spectacular views of the isle of Dragonera , just off the coast.
The area also boasts beautiful beaches with golden sands and clear waters, making this the ideal place to relax and enjoy the sea and the sunshine.

A picturesque village, with narrow cobblestone streets that meander around whitewashed houses and small shops and restaurants, the main square is the heart of the community, where residents and visitors get together to enjoy a meal al fresco or just wander around and enjoy the relaxing atmosphere.

Boat trips to visit Dragonera Island are available from San Telmo’s harbour, the perfect way for visitors to discover this protected nature reserve with its rich wildlife and take the opportunity to do some hiking or snorkelling.
San Telmo is close to the impressive Sierra de Tramuntana , a mountain range that has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site because of its cultural importance and stunning natural beauty.
This proximity provides us with the opportunity to enjoy a wide range of excursions and hiking routes such as La Trapa or Puig de Galatzó.
San Telmo is just a 45-minute drive from Palma airport which has routes connecting Spain’s major cities and the European capitals.

Floor Plans SIX SENSES RESIDENCES DUBAI MARINA Apartment Penthouse Share A Life Lived Well For three decades, Six Senses has helped people reconnect with themselves, with others and with the world around them.
At Dubai Marina, that philosophy comes home.
Rising 122 storeys above the Marina, the tower makes room for the things that keep you well: a swim before breakfast, an hour of stillness, sleep that restores, and time with the people you love.

It is the first standalone residential tower from Six Senses, developed by Select Group after the completed Six Senses residences and resort on Palm Jumeirah, and designed around how you rest, move, eat and gather.
Construction is underway, with handover scheduled for 2029.
Designed Around Life Within Architecture by Woods Bagot and interiors by Mitchell & Eades are considered together, so every space feels calm,warm and connected to the light and views beyond.

Biophilic design and the principles of classical feng shui shape each home: natural timber andbronze, full-height glazing, and layouts that let the day unfold easily, from aquiet morning alone to an evening with friends.

Find Your Sense of Home 251 residences offer different ways to make Dubai Marina your own: two- to four-bedroom residences, four-bedroom half-floor penthouses, and four- and five-bedroom duplex and triplex Sky Mansions, each with space to live, retreat and entertain.
Every home is designed around wellbeing, with Sleep With Six Senses bedroom amenities, natural materials, and an approach to space and light informed by biophilia and classical feng shui.
From the windows, views reach across Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Harbour, Bluewaters and Ain Dubai to the Gulf, and inland to the greens of Emirates Golf Club.

It is understated luxury, made to be lived in rather than admired from a distance.
Full-height windows fill each room with natural light and open onto generous balconies above the water.

Balconies on opposite sides of the home bring dual-aspect views and natural light deep into every room.
Palm Jumeirah and the Gulf on one side, the city on the other: an outlook that changes with every hour, from sunrise coffee to the evening lights.

The latest project information, availability and handover updates should be confirmed with Danube Properties as the development progresses.
Where is Greenz by Danube located, and what are the key destinations and roads nearby?
Greenz by Danube is located near Academic City, Dubai.
It is close to Dubai Silicon Oasis, with major roads such as Emirates Road, Dubai-Al Ain Road, and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, providing excellent connectivity.
What is the starting price of Greenz by Danube?
3- and 4-bedroom townhouses and 5-bedroom villas start at AED 3.7 million.
But ownership starts with just a 20% down payment, followed by 1% monthly installments for the next 40 Months.
The final 40% payment is due only after project completion in Q4 2029.
Why choose Greenz by Danube?
What makes it different from a conventional residential development?
Greenz by Danube defines what it means to come home to luxury.
The private townhouses and villas, and the community they bring together, offer an extensive collection of lifestyle experiences.
With over 50 amenities, large green and lifestyle areas, wellness facilities, sports spaces, and family-oriented zones, Greenz becomes an investment worth living in.
What payment plan is available at Greenz by Danube?
Danube Properties offers a 1% monthly payment plan for Greenz by Danube, making it one of the most accessible villa options in the market.
The development is also eligible for Danube’s Summer Bonanza offer, subject to the applicable terms, availability, and promotional period.
Either way, true ownership starts with a down payment as little as 20%.
What amenities are available at Greenz by Danube?
Greenz by Danube offers a wide range of resort-style, wellness, sports and family-oriented amenities.

These include the Beach Hub, Dancing Fountain, Wellness Hub, Sports Hub, Beach Clubhouse, swimming pools, fitness facilities, indoor games, jogging areas, children’s play spaces, landscaped areas, cafes and security facilities.

The community is designed to combine green open spaces with recreational and lifestyle facilities, providing residents with opportunities for fitness, relaxation, entertainment and family activities within the development.
Are the villas at Greenz by Danube furnished?
Yes.

The residences at Greenz by Danube feature branded Italian furniture from Dolce Vita, and thoughtfully designed layouts and interiors that combine style, comfort, and functionality for modern family living.
Is Greenz by Danube eligible for the UAE Golden Visa?

With villas starting from AED 3.7 million, buyers qualify for the UAE Golden Visa threshold of AED 2 million through property investment, subject to meeting the applicable government requirements and eligibility criteria.
Is Greenz by Danube suitable for families?

Greenz by Danube is designed around spacious 3, 4 and 5-bedroom villas and includes family-oriented facilities such as children’s play areas, sports facilities, landscaped spaces, swimming pools, gardens and wellness amenities.
The townhouse and villa layouts also provide additional living space suited to larger households.
What are the nearest landmarks and destinations to Greenz by Danube?

Greenz by Danube is conveniently located close to major leisure destinations, with Silicon Central Mall just 10 minutes away, Dubai Safari Park around 11 minutes away, and IMG Worlds of Adventure and Global Village approximately 13 and 15 minutes away, respectively.

The development also offers easy access to key education, business, and travel hubs, with Dubai International Airport (DXB), Downtown Dubai, and Burj Khalifa accessible within a short 17-18 minute drive.
What are the sizes of the villas at Greenz by Danube?
The 3-bedroom townhouses start at around 2,350 sq.
ft., while 4-bedroom layouts range from 2,750 to 3,100 sq.
ft.
The 5-bedroom semi-detached villas are around 3,700 sq.
ft., while the larger twin villas extend to approximately 3,950 sq.
The overall Greenz development spans approximately 4.9 million sq.
ft., with around 400,000 sq.
dedicated to lifestyle amenities and green spaces.

Dubai’s historic waterfront into a contemporary residential landmark.

With distinctive residential towers, a dedicated business tower, and architecture inspired by the rhythms of the port and the sea, the development blends the legacy of the past with a bold vision for the future.

Offering residences from sleek studios to expansive duplex apartments, Portside Square is defined by flowing design, thoughtful interiors, and panoramic views of the marina, skyline, and sea – creating a lifestyle where heritage and modernity converge.

A community shaped by history yet inspired by the future, it embodies Dubai’s enduring connection to the sea and its spirit of transformation.

Le Blanc by Imtiaz is located in Dubailand , within the Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC).
The location offers access to major road networks, including E66 and E611 , supporting connectivity to key areas across Dubai.
2 What types of residences are available at Le Blanc?
Le Blanc features a mix of studio, 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, and 3-bedroom apartments , distributed across the residential floors of the tower.
3 How many units are there in Le Blanc by Imtiaz?

Le Blanc comprises a total of 323 residential units, broken down as follows: • 187 studios • 102 one-bedroom apartments • 17 two-bedroom apartments • 17 three-bedroom apartments 4 What is the overall concept of Le Blanc by Imtiaz?
Le Blanc is designed around a philosophy of minimal design with enduring elegance .
The development balances clean architectural expression with functional living spaces and lifestyle amenities, including rooftop leisure areas, shared social spaces, and wellness facilities.
5 What amenities are available at Le Blanc by Imtiaz?

The development offers a range of resident amenities, including: • Rooftop swimming pool • Gym • Clubhouse • Outdoor cinema • Outdoor dining and BBQ areas • Adult and kids’ pools 6 What payment plan options are available for Le Blanc by Imtiaz?
Le Blanc offers two structured payment plans: • Option 1: 60/40 Payment Plan 60% payable during construction, with 40% due on completion (June 2028).
• Option 2: 70/30 Payment Plan with Post-Handover 70% payable up to completion, with the remaining 30% payable post-handover over 3 years , in quarterly instalments.
7 When is Le Blanc by Imtiaz expected to be completed?
Construction of Le Blanc by Imtiaz is scheduled for completion in Q4 2028 , with final payment milestones aligned to the handover period.
8 How tall is Le Blanc by Imtiaz?
Le Blanc is a 21-storey residential tower with the following configuration: Basement + Ground + 3 Podiums + 17 Residential Floors + Rooftop (B+G+3P+17+R).
9 How are the floor layouts organised at Le Blanc?
The building includes basement and podium levels dedicated to parking, a ground-floor lobby, residential layouts from the 1st to 17th floors, and a rooftop level housing the pool, gym, and clubhouse.
Apartment layouts vary by floor while maintaining a consistent unit mix.

The development is surrounded by protected landscapes, including the Salgados Lagoon, and benefits from easy access to Albufeira, golf courses and Faro International Airport.
Construction of the development’s infrastructure is scheduled to begin in September/October 2026.

Home Ongoing Projects for Sale Ataşehir 173 Ataşehir 173 The New Face of Quiet Luxury in Ataşehir Ataşehir 173, realized with the assurance of DAP Real Estate and Emlak Konut, brings the "Quiet Luxury" concept to the city's financial center.
With its unpretentious, refined, and timeless architecture, it promises an exclusive lifestyle in Istanbul's most strategic location, away from the hustle and bustle but right in the heart of life.

Location İstanbul / Ataşehir --> --> INFORMATION FORM Ataşehir 173 Perfect Location, Distinguished Architecture Designed with the understanding that true luxury lies in simplicity, Ataşehir 173 offers its residents a private world that slows down time.
Possessing a timeless, characterful, and "timeless" architectural language, the project creates a life in harmony with the sky and nature thanks to its low-rise, horizontal structure.

The blocks, designed on a human scale, along with the extensive landscaped areas and the city park located right next to the project, completely separate it from the concrete jungle, creating a tranquil sanctuary in the heart of the metropolis.
The project rises in the most valuable location of Ataşehir, home to Istanbul's new financial hub and the heart of the business world.
Situated at a point overlooking both sides of the city, Ataşehir 173 is at the heart of transportation with its direct access to main connecting roads, bridges, and tunnels.
This strategic location, providing easy access to every point of Istanbul whether by road or public transport, allows you to perfectly balance work and social life.
The rich social amenities offered by the area become privileges that make life easier for the residents of Ataşehir 173.

The city's most prestigious shopping centers, fully equipped healthcare facilities, and established educational institutions are located in the immediate vicinity of the project, instantly meeting all your needs.

While you experience all the dynamism of the city outside, once inside you can enjoy "Quiet Luxury" with your limited number of neighbors, in social facilities such as a private indoor pool, spa, sauna, and fitness center.

MESA Yenikent, "Entegre Yaşam" konseptiyle sadece bir konut projesi değil, her anıyla canlı bir ekosistem sunuyor.
Projede; okul, alışveriş merkezi, kafeler, restoranlar yer alıyor.

Figures published online for Koh Samui (also spelled Ko Samui), Thailand, can vary threefold depending on who publishes them.
This page brings them together, cites every source, and sets them against the actual prices of Casa Una Residence, a developer in Chaweng.

No figure appears without its origin: the market data comes from six identified publications (Conrad Properties, FazWaz, WelcomeKeys, Samui & Koh, Varsovia Estate, Keller Henson); Casa Una prices come from our own published price list.

The essentials: 2026 prices in five figures The Koh Samui villa market runs from THB 5 million (around $135,000) for a basic house inland to more than THB 80 million for a beachfront property, according to Conrad Properties (2025).

Island-wide, the Samui & Koh 2026 market report puts the average price at THB 30.5 million and the median at THB 17.2 million — the gap is explained by a handful of ultra-luxury properties pulling the average upwards, with the most active price band sitting between THB 10 and 15 million.
On the listing portals, FazWaz records around 980 villas for sale on Koh Samui in September 2026, with a median price of around $484,968 and a median price per square metre of around $2,448.
The price per square metre observed by Varsovia Estate (March 2026) ranges from THB 80,000 to 160,000 depending on area and standard.

For new off-plan builds in Chaweng, Casa Una Residence publishes its prices openly: a one-bedroom villa from €145,000 (THB 5,500,000), two bedrooms from €166,000 (THB 6,300,000), four bedrooms from €261,000 (THB 9,900,000), with completion scheduled for the fourth quarter of 2027.
→ In 2026, the median villa price on Koh Samui is THB 17.2 million (Samui & Koh); a new off-plan villa in Chaweng starts at €145,000 (THB 5.5 million) with Casa Una.
The number of bedrooms is the first driver of price.
On the resale market, FazWaz shows a median price of around $484,968 across nearly 980 villas for sale on Koh Samui in September 2026.

Samui & Koh (2026) segments the supply into three bands: THB 5 to 12 million for an entry-level garden-view villa, THB 12 to 25 million for a partial sea view, and THB 25 to 70 million for sea-view luxury.
The table below sets the launch prices of the three Casa Una collections in Chaweng — published in full, excluding the furniture pack — against sourced market benchmarks for each configuration.

For an identical configuration, the area alone can double the price.
The ranges below are those published by market players between May 2025 and March 2026; we cite the source for each line rather than blending figures of different origins.

Chaweng — the island's tourist heart, stretching along Chaweng Beach, and home to Casa Una Residence — is, paradoxically, poorly documented in public price ranges: Conrad Properties publishes figures only for Chaweng Noi (THB 18 to 55 million), and the closest example of a villa for sale at WelcomeKeys is listed at €290,000 (November 2025).
That is precisely why we publish our own prices in plain sight: in Chaweng, new off-plan Casa Una villas start at €145,000.

For Choeng Mon, none of the six sources analysed publishes a price range for 2026; Samui & Koh simply ranks the island's north-east (Choeng Mon, Plai Laem, Bophut, Chaweng Noi) among the best areas to buy a villa.
The only neighbouring published figure is an example in Plai Laem at €260,000 (WelcomeKeys, November 2025).

Three public references frame the price per square metre in 2026.
Varsovia Estate (March 2026) places the market between THB 80,000 and 160,000 per m² and notes that Koh Samui remains cheaper than Phuket.
FazWaz shows a median of around $2,448 per m² across its villas for sale, recorded in September 2026.
WelcomeKeys (November 2025) publishes €3,200 to €5,500 per m² for Samui against €3,800 to €6,200 per m² for Phuket.
These three sources do not measure the same thing — online listings for FazWaz, a curated portfolio for WelcomeKeys, a market estimate for Varsovia — hence the different levels.
They converge on one point, however: the square metre on Koh Samui remains below Phuket's in both comparisons that measure it.
Casa Una publishes its prices per villa, not per square metre: what commits the buyer is the full price of the property, not a ratio.
For comparison, launch prices range from €145,000 (UNA Nest, one bedroom) to €261,000 (UNA Signature, four bedrooms), in Chaweng, completion Q4 2027.

→ The price per square metre for a Koh Samui villa in 2026 sits between THB 80,000 and 160,000 according to Varsovia Estate, with a median of around $2,448 per m² across FazWaz listings — below Phuket's levels in both comparative sources.
The advertised price is not the full cost of the purchase.

The transfer rates cited by Conrad Properties (2025) are as follows: a transfer fee of 2% (often split between buyer and seller), stamp duty of 0.5% or Specific Business Tax of 3.3% if the seller resells within five years, and withholding tax of 1% for corporate sellers.
On the total, published estimates diverge sharply — and it pays to know this before budgeting.
Conrad Properties puts transfer fees and taxes at 3 to 6% of the price, with lawyer's fees of THB 150,000 to 450,000.
WelcomeKeys (November 2025) quotes around 1 to 2% on the buyer's side, a lawyer at THB 20,000–50,000, and a full worked example of €3,400 in costs on a €320,000 villa.
The gap comes down to scope (how fees are split with the seller, level of legal service): always ask for a line-by-line breakdown before signing.
Then comes furniture, essential for premium lettings: Conrad estimates it at 5 to 10% of the property's value.
At Casa Una, this item is a fixed pack known in advance: €10,000 (THB 370,000) for UNA Nest, €14,000 (THB 530,000) for UNA Horizon, €26,000 (THB 1,000,000) for UNA Signature.

Buying off-plan means acquiring the villa before or during construction, at a launch price set before completion.
In a growing market like Chaweng, a latent capital gain can build up before the first night is ever let — with no guarantee, as it depends on how the market evolves.

The resale market opens lower in absolute terms — from THB 5 million (around $135,000) for a basic house inland, according to Conrad Properties (2025) — but concerns existing properties whose condition, legal structure and rental history must be audited case by case.
The second difference is the payment schedule.
A resale is paid in full at signing; an off-plan purchase is staged over the build.

At Casa Una, the reservation commits 5% of the price, and the balance follows actual construction progress: construction start in July 2026, completion in the fourth quarter of 2027 (around 12 to 18 months of works), then 4 to 8 weeks of fit-out before letting begins.

Among new builds other than Casa Una, Keller Henson (March 2026) lists developments from THB 6.99 million in Maenam (Samui Grand Park Hill Phase 2, leasehold) and from THB 7.5 million leasehold in Lamai (Naga Kiri Villas) — levels consistent with our launch price list in Chaweng (THB 5.5 to 9.9 million), an area that is nonetheless more central.

Conrad Properties (2025) identifies five price factors, which our own experience as a developer confirms: location and view, land tenure (freehold or leasehold), build quality, villa and plot size, and the developer's legal reliability.
Two of these factors can be quantified with published data.
Location first: at comparable standard, Conrad places Chaweng Noi between THB 18 and 55 million while Maenam trades between THB 7 and 20 million — a ratio of nearly three to one.

Land tenure next: on the same project in Lamai (Naga Kiri Villas), Keller Henson (March 2026) records THB 7.5 million leasehold against THB 11.5 million freehold — a gap of roughly 53% for the same property, depending on the rights acquired over the land.
For a rental investment, location counts double: it sets the purchase price, but also occupancy and the nightly rate.
That is the reason for Casa Una's position in Chaweng, the island's most central area, with published launch prices of €145,000 to €261,000.

→ On a single project in Lamai, the leasehold/freehold gap reaches THB 4 million (7.5 vs 11.5 million THB, Keller Henson, March 2026); between areas, Conrad measures a ratio of nearly one to three between Maenam and Chaweng Noi.
Price and rental income: how to read the published figures A purchase price can only be judged against the income it generates — and this is where publications diverge most.

For a Koh Samui villa, Samui & Koh (2026) publishes a gross yield of 7 to 10% and a net yield of 5 to 8%; Conrad Properties (2025) arrives at the same 5 to 8% net range, with a detailed example at 7.0% net on a THB 30 million villa at 70% occupancy; WelcomeKeys quotes 9 to 12% net on its portfolio; and Keller Henson relays developer projections of up to 15.7% net.
These gaps come from the assumptions: entry price, occupancy rate, nightly rate and, above all, the scope of costs deducted.
For Casa Una, we have made a different choice: no percentage, but an estimated rental income in euros, with every cost itemised.
The starting point is gross income: nights rented × average nightly rate, based on the rates in our official brochure, from 65% to 88% occupancy.

From this we deduct the Airbnb/Booking commission (15%), rental management and concierge (15%), the land lease rent (THB 7,000–12,500 per month depending on the villa, set in the contract, +5% every 5 years), co-ownership fees covering the pool, garden, gym, spa, pest control and waste collection (THB 8,000–8,500 per month; the calculation uses the top of the range), water (THB 250 per month), and finally a maintenance and furniture renewal reserve (5% of gross).
Electricity, which depends on each villa's consumption (public PEA tariff), is not included.

The result, before electricity, rental income tax, property tax and insurance: an estimated net income of €17,400 to €25,300 per year for a UNA Nest (one bedroom), €24,800 to €35,500 for a UNA Horizon (two bedrooms) and €42,000 to €59,200 for a UNA Signature (four bedrooms).
The table below summarises these figures; each villa's page publishes the calculation line by line, cost by cost.
These are estimates, not guaranteed income: occupancy and nightly rates depend on the market.
Rental income should always be audited on three variables — purchase price, nightly rate and occupancy — and on the full list of costs deducted: that holds for our figures as for any seller's.

The market runs from THB 5 million (around $135,000) to more than THB 80 million according to Conrad Properties (2025).
The island's median is THB 17.2 million per Samui & Koh (2026), and the FazWaz portal shows a median price of around $484,968 across nearly 980 villas for sale (September 2026).
For new off-plan builds in Chaweng, Casa Una Residence starts at €145,000 (THB 5,500,000) for a one-bedroom villa.
How much does a new villa in Chaweng cost?

At Casa Una Residence, a new off-plan project in Chaweng completing in the fourth quarter of 2027, launch prices are €145,000 (THB 5,500,000) for a one-bedroom UNA Nest villa, €166,000 (THB 6,300,000) for a two-bedroom UNA Horizon and €261,000 (THB 9,900,000) for a four-bedroom UNA Signature, excluding the furniture pack.
For comparison, WelcomeKeys published an example of a villa for sale in Chaweng at €290,000 in November 2025.
What is the price per square metre for a villa in Koh Samui?
Between THB 80,000 and 160,000 per m² according to Varsovia Estate (March 2026).

FazWaz shows a median of around $2,448 per m² across its villa listings (September 2026), and WelcomeKeys (November 2025) publishes €3,200 to €5,500 per m² for Koh Samui against €3,800 to €6,200 per m² for Phuket — Samui remains cheaper than Phuket in both sources that compare the two islands.
What deposit do you need to reserve an off-plan villa?
At Casa Una, the reservation commits 5% of the villa's price.
The balance follows construction progress: 10% at contract signing, 20% at construction start, 30% at phase 2, 30% at phase 3 and 5% at key handover, scheduled for the fourth quarter of 2027.
What costs come on top of the purchase price of a villa in Thailand?

The rates cited by Conrad Properties (2025): a 2% transfer fee (often split), 0.5% stamp duty or 3.3% Specific Business Tax on resale within 5 years, 1% withholding tax for corporate sellers, plus lawyer's fees.
In total, Conrad estimates 3 to 6% of the price, while WelcomeKeys quotes around 1 to 2% on the buyer's side.
Add furniture: at Casa Una, a fixed pack of €10,000 (one bedroom), €14,000 (two bedrooms) or €26,000 (four bedrooms).
What rental yield can you expect from a villa in Koh Samui?
Published net yields for the market range from 5–8% (Samui & Koh 2026, Conrad Properties 2025) to 9–12% (WelcomeKeys, November 2025) depending on the assumptions used.

These are estimates, not guaranteed income.

Read more Welcome to Wickside: a brand new canal-side neighbourhood in Hackney Wick, East London.

Soon to be home to 63 private apartments alongside various retail offerings, residents of our Wickside apartments will be strategically placed close to Hackney Wick Overground station and the wealth of local waterfront bars, restaurants and diverse culture that the area offers.

Set to comprise a selection of one-, two-- and three-bedroom lateral apartments and duplexes; each property will exude highly refined interior specifications with an industrial-chic style at the core of the design.

Each property will benefit from private outside space in the form of a balcony or terrace, many of which directly overlook the tranquillity of the Hertford Union Canal, whilst communal rooftop gardens will also be available for residents’ exclusive use.
Hackney Wick’s vibrant and rapidly evolving community has been transformed into a creative hub of repurposed warehouses, studios and trendy lifestyle hotspots in recent years.

Bordered by the River Lee and the Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, Hackney Wick boasts ample opportunities to enjoy the outdoors, whether to walk the dog, run, or socialise with friends at one of Hackney Wick’s many canalside venues.
Its thriving cultural scene is highly popular with young creatives and professionals who enjoy the local artistic spirit with the area’s ample street art, galleries and urban charm.

Read more Wickside will have everything residents could possibly need all in one place for a life of ease, from leisure and recreational facilities, to art studios and workspaces, to retail and dining.
The development is flanked by three notable open spaces, including the beautiful Victoria Park, numerous stations and dozens of independent bistros, bars, boutiques, arenas and entertainment venues.

Just a stone’s throw from the development, residents will find the hippest segment of the Hertford Union Canal; stroll or cycle along this scenic part of East London and soak up the bohemian, “anything goes” ambience.
You’ll be sure to discover all sorts of artsy water-front cafés and pubs, floating boutiques and dog walkers.

When it comes to indulging in retail therapy, Europe’s largest mall, Westfield Stratford, is just one stop away on the Overground or a 14 minute walk, and is home to over 300 shops, 50 restaurants and a cinema.
Read less Transport Wickside is superbly connected for all forms of transport.
Hackney Wick station is a three minute walk from the development and operates an Overground service, connecting passengers to Stratford in as little as three minutes.

From Stratford station, a choice of three Underground line services — the Central line, the Jubilee line and the all-new Crossrail service, the Elizabeth line — connects passengers to destinations such as Canary Wharf, Bank, Bond Street and Paddington.
Meanwhile, the DLR transports passengers to the Docklands and London City Airport within 14 minutes.

Read more Galliard Homes and Apsley House Capital proudly present St Paul’s Quarter , the latest joint venture in The Galliard Apsley Partnership scheme.

Located in Birmingham’s vibrant Jewellery Quarter, this exciting mixed-use development has planning permission for residential, commercial, and amenity space as well as 33% affordable workspaces for local makers and creatives.
As well as planning for 422 high-quality residential units, St Paul’s Quarter will comprise an impressive 6,211 sq.
m.
of commercial and business space, providing residents with an excellent choice of shops, restaurants and bars.

The four-acre development will integrate the Jewellery Quarter to Northwood Street with a new pedestrian walkway connecting the two together, known as Harpers Hill, making it quicker for residents to access Birmingham’s Central Business District (CBD), which is only a 10 minute walk away.

Read more The UK’s second largest city and third largest urban area, Birmingham offers everything from buzzing nightlife to peaceful canal walks in green parks.

The city boasts an incredible choice of bars and places to eat, including five Michelin starred restaurants and many fantastic entertainment venues hosting live events such as the famously popular theatre, The Hippodrome; situated merely 20 minutes’ walk away from Jewellery Quarter in the district that is also home to the city’s vibrant Chinese Quarter and Gay Village.
Located just 10 minutes’ walk away from St Paul’s Quarter, the Bullring & Grand Central is a shopper’s paradise with over 200 stores.
Read less Transport Birmingham is home to an impressive 35 railway and metro stations, all offering speedy transport links to London and beyond.

Both Birmingham New Street station and Birmingham Snow Hill railway station are less than a 20 minute walk away and provide services to London Euston, London Marylebone, Stratford-upon-Avon and Manchester Piccadilly; all accessible in under 90 minutes.
Curzon Street station — the new home of HS2 — will be 27 minutes’ walk away from St Paul’s Quarter and, once completed, London will be just under an hour away.
Residents of St Paul’s Quarter will also be able to reach the new HS2 station from Jewellery Quarter Metro Station (which is a seven minute walk from the development).
With the M5, M6, M40 and M42 surrounding Birmingham, motorists will have easy access to numerous A-roads and motorways.
